lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第74单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。
sents.p: tā chuān zhuó yī fu chōng jìn fáng jiān
sents.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.

sents.zh: 每个人都向我们冲来。
sents.p: měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǒ men chōng lái
sents.en: Everybody rushed towards us.

sents.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法。
sents.p: wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shàng de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.

sents.zh: 我们很期待见到您和您的家人。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn qī dài jiàn dào nín hé nín de jiā rén
sents.en: We are looking forward to seeing you and your family.

sents.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
sents.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

sents.zh: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。
sents.p: zhèng zhì jiā cóng lái bù gào sù wǒ men tā men de bié yǒu yòng xīn
sents.en: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.

sents.zh: 她朝我丢葡萄，我试着用嘴接住它们。
sents.p: tā cháo wǒ diū pú tao wǒ shì zhe yòng zuǐ jiē zhù tā men
sents.en: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.

sents.zh: 那个朝我们跑过来的男孩是谁？
sents.p: nà gè cháo wǒ men pǎo guò lái de nán hái shì shéi
sents.en: Who is that boy running toward us?

sents.zh: 这药没有副作用。
sents.p: zhè yào méi yǒu fù zuò yòng
sents.en: This medicine has no side effects.

sents.zh: 他继承了他父亲的事业。
sents.p: tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de shì yè
sents.en: He took over his father's business.

sents.zh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
sents.p: tā fù qīn bǎ yī shēng dōu gòng xiàn gěi kē xué shì yè le
sents.en: Her father devoted his life to science.

sents.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
sents.p: wǒ chéng rèn zhè kě néng bù shì zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ
sents.en: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.

sents.zh: 你能承认你错了是很伟大的。
sents.p: nǐ néng chéng rèn nǐ cuò le shì hěn wěi dà de
sents.en: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.

sents.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū zhí xíng tā de mìng lìng
sents.en: We must execute his orders.

sents.zh: 我相信他的执行能力。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā de zhí xíng néng lì
sents.en: I trust his executive ability.

sents.zh: 他不在这儿你不觉得这很奇怪吗？
sents.p: tā bù zài zhèr nǐ bù jué de zhè hěn qí guài ma
sents.en: Don't you think it's strange that he's not here?

sents.zh: 动物园里有很多奇怪的动物。
sents.p: dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de dòng wù
sents.en: There are some strange animals in the zoo.

sents.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
sents.en: Are you in pain now?

sents.zh: 显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。
sents.p: xiǎn rán jīn tiān shén me shì dōu yǒu kě néng fā shēng
sents.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.

sents.zh: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。
sents.p: zhè xiǎn rán shì jīn nián chū bǎn de zuì hǎo de xiǎo shuō
sents.en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.

sents.zh: 因为健康状况不佳，他没去成旅行。
sents.p: yīn wèi jiàn kāng zhuàng kuàng bù jiā tā méi qù chéng lǚ xíng
sents.en: Poor health prohibited him from traveling.

sents.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
sents.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shàng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
sents.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

sents.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
sents.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
sents.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

sents.zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu dà liàng de shū zài wǒ de shū jià shàng
sents.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.

sents.zh: 你用了多少时间来翻译这本书？
sents.p: nǐ yòng le duō shǎo shí jiān lái fān yì zhè běn shū
sents.en: How long did it take you to translate this book?

sents.zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
sents.p: shì jiè jiù xiàng shì yī běn shū zǒu yī bù děng yú fān le yī yè
sents.en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.

sents.zh: 他是时代杂志的记者。
sents.p: tā shì shí dài zá zhì de jì zhě
sents.en: He is a reporter for Time magazine.

sents.zh: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。
sents.p: wǒ men jīn tiān suǒ rèn shi de gōng yè zài nà gè shí dài bù cún zài
sents.en: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.

sents.zh: 他是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。
sents.p: tā shì shì jiè shàng zuì wěi dà de kē xué jiā zhī yī
sents.en: He is numbered among the greatest scientists in the world.

sents.zh: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。
sents.p: tā shì rì běn zuì wěi dà de yì shù jiā zhī yī
sents.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.

sents.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiè shí jiān
sents.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

sents.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
sents.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
sents.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

sents.zh: 我想要一颗糖。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī kē táng
sents.en: I want a piece of candy.

sents.zh: 我心里充满着快乐。
sents.p: wǒ xīn li chōng mǎn zhe kuài lè
sents.en: My heart was filled with happiness.

sents.zh: 自然充满了神秘。
sents.p: zì rán chōng mǎn le shén mì
sents.en: Nature is full of mysteries.

sents.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
sents.p: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
sents.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

sents.zh: 海王星是太阳系第八个行星。
sents.p: hǎi wáng xīng shì tài yang xì dì bā gè xíng xīng
sents.en: Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.

sents.zh: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。
sents.p: wǒ bù jīn xiǎng wǒ de ér zi yī zhí dōu zài shēng
sents.en: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.

sents.zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
sents.p: guò qù wǒ fù qīn cháng cháng hē jiǔ zhí dào shēn yè
sents.en: My father used to drink till late at night.

sents.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。
sents.p: zhè gè guó jiā de zhǔ yào chǎn pǐn zhī yī shì kā fēi
sents.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.

sents.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
sents.p: wǒ men zài diàn shì shàng xuān chuán wǒ men de chǎn pǐn
sents.en: We advertise our products on TV.

sents.zh: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。
sents.p: tā pǎo de hěn kuài shì wèi le gǎn shàng qí tā chéng yuán
sents.en: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.

sents.zh: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。
sents.p: jǐn sān fēn zhī yī de chéng yuán chū xí le huì yì
sents.en: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.

sents.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
sents.p: wàn yī chuán yùn chí le wǒ men yǒu tè bié de chí dào bǎo xiǎn
sents.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.

sents.zh: 保险箱的钥匙在我这儿。
sents.p: bǎo xiǎn xiāng de yào shi zài wǒ zhèr
sents.en: I have the key to the safe.

sents.zh: 我的意见是，你该再次参加测试。
sents.p: wǒ de yì jiàn shì nǐ gāi zài cì cān jiā cè shì
sents.en: I think you should take the test again.

sents.zh: 我觉得这个测试很难。
sents.p: wǒ jué de zhè gè cè shì hěn nán
sents.en: I found the test difficult.

sents.zh: 我们需要称职的领导人。
sents.p: wǒ men xū yào chèn zhí de lǐng dǎo rén
sents.en: We need competent leaders.

sents.zh: 我正在为我的妈妈寻找礼物。
sents.p: wǒ zhèng zài wèi wǒ de mā ma xún zhǎo lǐ wù
sents.en: I am looking for a present for my mother.

sents.zh: 我应该寻找什么？
sents.p: wǒ yīng gāi xún zhǎo shén me
sents.en: What should I look for?

sents.zh: 她理所当然的取得了胜利。
sents.p: tā lǐ suǒ dāng rán de qǔ dé le shèng lì
sents.en: She's sure to succeed.

sents.zh: 正义终将胜利。
sents.p: zhèng yì zhōng jiāng shèng lì
sents.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

sents.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
sents.p: shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng
sents.en: Who's your favorite TV star?

sents.zh: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。
sents.p: wǒ de xiōng dì hé wǒ zài yī gè bān jí
sents.en: My brother and I are in the same class.

sents.zh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
sents.p: bèi gào huì xiàng shàng jí fǎ yuàn shàng sù
sents.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
sents.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

sents.zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
sents.p: yī gè guó jiā zhǐ de chǎn liàng hé tā de wén míng chéng dù mì qiè xiāng guān
sents.en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.

sents.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。
sents.p: wǒ bù zài de shí hou tā jiāng shì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
sents.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.

sents.zh: 我必须不惜一切代价帮助她。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū bù xī yī qiè dài jià bāng zhù tā
sents.en: I must help her at any cost.

sents.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。
sents.p: zhè gè lǐ lùn duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán le lǐ jiě bù liǎo
sents.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.

sents.zh: 我不想听你的理论。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng tīng nǐ de lǐ lùn
sents.en: I don't want to hear your theories.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢以这种方式被对待。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan yǐ zhè zhǒng fāng shì bèi duì dài
sents.en: I don't like being treated like this.

sents.zh: 笔记本电脑比台式电脑好。
sents.p: bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo bǐ tái shì diàn nǎo hǎo
sents.en: A laptop is better than a desktop.

sents.zh: 他宣布与她订婚。
sents.p: tā xuān bù yǔ tā dìng hūn
sents.en: He announced his engagement to her.

sents.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
sents.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
sents.en: The medicine worked marvels.

sents.zh: 这台琴应该好多年没调过音了。
sents.p: zhè tái qín yīng gāi hǎo duō nián méi diào guò yīn le
sents.en: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.

sents.zh: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ wèi nǐ diào bēi rè yǐn liào ma
sents.en: Can I fix you a hot drink?

sents.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
sents.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
sents.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

sents.zh: 我喜欢在队伍里。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan zài duì wǔ lǐ
sents.en: I like being on the team.

sents.zh: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。
sents.p: hǎo rén bù cháng mìng shì jù huò zhēn huò jià de lǎo huà
sents.en: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.

sents.zh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
sents.p: tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le nà tiáo gǒu
sents.en: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.

sents.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。
sents.p: kàn wán zhè fēng xìn qǐng bǎ tā shāo diào
sents.en: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.

sents.zh: 我喜欢烧烤食物。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan shāo kǎo shí wù
sents.en: I love barbecue.

sents.zh: 交通事故没有一天是不在发生的。
sents.p: jiāo tōng shì gù méi yǒu yī tiān shì bù zài fā shēng de
sents.en: Not a day passes without traffic accidents.

sents.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
sents.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn
sents.en: Most accidents happen near home.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

items.en: calm; peaceful; to calm; to set at ease

ex.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。
ex.p: rén men dōu shuō dōng jīng shì zuò hěn ān quán de chéng shì
ex.en: It's said that Tokyo is a very safe city.

ex.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
ex.p: wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
ex.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.

ex.zh: 我认为考试破坏教育。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi kǎo shì pò huài jiào yù
ex.en: I think exams ruin education.

ex.zh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
ex.p: tā huī zhe tā de shǒu zhí dào huǒ chē xiāo shī zài shì xiàn zhī wài
ex.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

ex.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
ex.p: cóng shān shàng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
ex.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

ex.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
ex.en: That's a huge challenge.

ex.zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？
ex.p: nǐ zài nǐ de chuáng xià miàn cáng le duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?

ex.zh: 他藏到一个大石头后面了。
ex.p: tā cáng dào yī gè dà shí tou hòu mian le
ex.en: He hid himself behind a large rock.

ex.zh: 我喜欢火龙果。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan huǒ lóng guǒ
ex.en: I like dragon fruit.

items.en: to satisfy; to meet (the needs of)

ex.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn zú
ex.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

ex.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
ex.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
ex.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

ex.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
ex.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

ex.zh: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。
ex.p: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn qì chē pèi jiàn
ex.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.

ex.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
ex.p: tā mǎi tǔ dì mù dì shì yào zào fáng zi
ex.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

ex.zh: 他威胁要公开。
ex.p: tā wēi xié yào gōng kāi
ex.en: He threatened to make it public.

ex.zh: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。
ex.p: wǒ zài guó wài lǚ xíng de shí hou wǒ lǎo pó lǎo gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: My wife often telephones me when I'm traveling in another country.

ex.zh: 我不想做你老婆了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zuò nǐ lǎo pó le
ex.en: I no longer wish to be your wife.

ex.zh: 没人知道等待我们的是什么。
ex.p: méi rén zhī dào děng dài wǒ men de shì shén me
ex.en: No one knew what awaited us.

ex.zh: 所有你能做的就是等待。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu nǐ néng zuò de jiù shì děng dài
ex.en: All you can do is wait.

ex.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
ex.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

ex.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
ex.en: That's a huge challenge.

items.en: to take possession of; to occupy

ex.zh: 她告诉了他自己相信占星术。
ex.p: tā gào sù le tā zì jǐ xiāng xìn zhàn xīng shù
ex.en: She told him that she believed in astrology.

ex.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
ex.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piàn lǐng tǔ
ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

ex.zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de mì mì gào sù le tā de péng you
ex.en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.

ex.zh: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。
ex.p: wǒ men dǎ suàn ràng nǐ zhī dào zhè gè mì mì
ex.en: We intended to let you in on the secret.

ex.zh: 我曾经像猪一样吃。
ex.p: wǒ céng jīng xiàng zhū yī yàng chī
ex.en: I used to eat like a pig.

ex.zh: 猪肉不适合我。
ex.p: zhū ròu bù shì hé wǒ
ex.en: Pork doesn't agree with me.

ex.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
ex.p: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng
ex.en: This probably means war.

ex.zh: 沉默就意味着同意。
ex.p: chén mò jiù yì wèi zhe tóng yì
ex.en: Silence gives consent.

items.en: to defend; to protect; to keep

ex.zh: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi gào sù hái zi zěn me bǎo hù zì jǐ
ex.en: We should tell children how to protect themselves.

ex.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi tā bù xū yào tā men de bǎo hù
ex.en: He did not think he needed their protection.

ex.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
ex.p: nà gè tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ
ex.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

ex.zh: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
ex.p: dài hái zi tuán tǐ qù tú shū guǎn yī diǎn wèn tí dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.

ex.zh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
ex.p: tā wèi tā de chí dào zhì zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
ex.en: He invented an excuse for being late.

ex.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
ex.p: tā men zhī dào rú hé zhì zào yuán zǐ dàn
ex.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.

ex.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
ex.p: tā mí lù le jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
ex.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

ex.zh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de
ex.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.

items.en: to draw out; to pull out from in between

ex.zh: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。
ex.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng chōu yān de huà nín bì xū chū qù
ex.en: You must go outside if you want to smoke.

ex.zh: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。
ex.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ huì chōu yī tiān lái kàn nǐ de
ex.en: I'll come and see you one of these days.

ex.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
ex.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
ex.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

ex.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shàng xíng zǒu ma
ex.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

ex.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
ex.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

ex.zh: 你还以为我不需要那么做，不是吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ bù xū yào nà me zuò bù shì ma
ex.en: You thought I didn't need to do that, didn't you?

ex.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。
ex.p: nǐ huì xū yào yī gè tè shū de gōng jù lái zuò zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.

ex.zh: 你具体需要些什么？
ex.p: nǐ jù tǐ xū yào xiē shén me
ex.en: What do you need exactly?

ex.zh: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā nián qīng yī diǎn tā jiāng hěn shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi
ex.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.

ex.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
ex.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

ex.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
ex.p: yī gè yǒu míng de jiàn zhù shī zào le zhè gè fáng zi
ex.en: A famous architect built this house.

ex.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
ex.p: zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
ex.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

ex.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
ex.p: dà zì rán zài wǒ men de shēng huó zhōng bàn yǎn zhuó zhòng yào de jué sè
ex.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.

ex.zh: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng wú fǎ yòng yǔ yán biǎo dá tā de gǎn jué le
ex.en: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.

ex.zh: 你想表达什么？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng biǎo dá shén me
ex.en: What do you mean?

items.en: to throw into; to put into

ex.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shàng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
ex.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

ex.zh: 人们认为，他完全能胜任这个工作。
ex.p: rén men rèn wéi tā wán quán néng shèng rèn zhè gè gōng zuò
ex.en: He was considered very qualified for the job.

ex.zh: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。
ex.p: wǒ ài nǐ shèng guò qí tā rèn hé yī gè rén
ex.en: I love you more than anyone else.

ex.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng què bǎo zhè yī qiè huì fā shēng
ex.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.

ex.zh: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
ex.p: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé
ex.en: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.

ex.zh: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me bǎ nǐ xīn jiàn de fáng zi mài le
ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?

ex.zh: 我建议，为了礼貌起见，我们尽可能少喝。
ex.p: wǒ jiàn yì wèi le lǐ mào qǐ jiàn wǒ men jǐn kě néng shǎo hē
ex.en: I suggest we drink as little as possible to be polite.

ex.zh: 你年龄足够大了，该了解更多。
ex.p: nǐ nián líng zú gòu dà le gāi liǎo jiě gēng duō
ex.en: You're old enough to know better.

ex.zh: 我们没有足够的时间来完成手头的工作。
ex.p: wǒ men méi yǒu zú gòu de shí jiān lái wán chéng shǒu tóu de gōng zuò
ex.en: We didn't have enough time to finish what we were doing.

ex.zh: 我们知道我们的权利。
ex.p: wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì
ex.en: We know our rights.

ex.zh: 他应该有权利去自己做决定。
ex.p: tā yīng gāi yǒu quán lì qù zì jǐ zuò jué dìng
ex.en: He should have the right to decide for himself.

items.en: to take (a picture); to shoot (a film)

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第75单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。
sents.p: rén men dōu shuō dōng jīng shì zuò hěn ān quán de chéng shì
sents.en: It's said that Tokyo is a very safe city.

sents.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
sents.p: wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
sents.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.

sents.zh: 我认为考试破坏教育。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi kǎo shì pò huài jiào yù
sents.en: I think exams ruin education.

sents.zh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
sents.p: tā huī zhe tā de shǒu zhí dào huǒ chē xiāo shī zài shì xiàn zhī wài
sents.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

sents.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
sents.p: cóng shān shàng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
sents.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

sents.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
sents.en: That's a huge challenge.

sents.zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？
sents.p: nǐ zài nǐ de chuáng xià miàn cáng le duō shǎo qián
sents.en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?

sents.zh: 他藏到一个大石头后面了。
sents.p: tā cáng dào yī gè dà shí tou hòu mian le
sents.en: He hid himself behind a large rock.

sents.zh: 我喜欢火龙果。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan huǒ lóng guǒ
sents.en: I like dragon fruit.

sents.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn zú
sents.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

sents.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
sents.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
sents.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

sents.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
sents.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
sents.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

sents.zh: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。
sents.p: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn qì chē pèi jiàn
sents.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.

sents.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
sents.p: tā mǎi tǔ dì mù dì shì yào zào fáng zi
sents.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

sents.zh: 他威胁要公开。
sents.p: tā wēi xié yào gōng kāi
sents.en: He threatened to make it public.

sents.zh: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。
sents.p: wǒ zài guó wài lǚ xíng de shí hou wǒ lǎo pó lǎo gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
sents.en: My wife often telephones me when I'm traveling in another country.

sents.zh: 我不想做你老婆了。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zuò nǐ lǎo pó le
sents.en: I no longer wish to be your wife.

sents.zh: 没人知道等待我们的是什么。
sents.p: méi rén zhī dào děng dài wǒ men de shì shén me
sents.en: No one knew what awaited us.

sents.zh: 所有你能做的就是等待。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu nǐ néng zuò de jiù shì děng dài
sents.en: All you can do is wait.

sents.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
sents.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
sents.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

sents.zh: 她告诉了他自己相信占星术。
sents.p: tā gào sù le tā zì jǐ xiāng xìn zhàn xīng shù
sents.en: She told him that she believed in astrology.

sents.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
sents.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piàn lǐng tǔ
sents.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

sents.zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā de mì mì gào sù le tā de péng you
sents.en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.

sents.zh: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。
sents.p: wǒ men dǎ suàn ràng nǐ zhī dào zhè gè mì mì
sents.en: We intended to let you in on the secret.

sents.zh: 我曾经像猪一样吃。
sents.p: wǒ céng jīng xiàng zhū yī yàng chī
sents.en: I used to eat like a pig.

sents.zh: 猪肉不适合我。
sents.p: zhū ròu bù shì hé wǒ
sents.en: Pork doesn't agree with me.

sents.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
sents.p: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng
sents.en: This probably means war.

sents.zh: 沉默就意味着同意。
sents.p: chén mò jiù yì wèi zhe tóng yì
sents.en: Silence gives consent.

sents.zh: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi gào sù hái zi zěn me bǎo hù zì jǐ
sents.en: We should tell children how to protect themselves.

sents.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。
sents.p: tā rèn wéi tā bù xū yào tā men de bǎo hù
sents.en: He did not think he needed their protection.

sents.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
sents.p: nà gè tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ
sents.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

sents.zh: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
sents.p: dài hái zi tuán tǐ qù tú shū guǎn yī diǎn wèn tí dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.

sents.zh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
sents.p: tā wèi tā de chí dào zhì zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
sents.en: He invented an excuse for being late.

sents.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
sents.p: tā men zhī dào rú hé zhì zào yuán zǐ dàn
sents.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.

sents.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
sents.p: tā mí lù le jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
sents.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

sents.zh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de
sents.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.

sents.zh: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。
sents.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng chōu yān de huà nín bì xū chū qù
sents.en: You must go outside if you want to smoke.

sents.zh: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。
sents.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ huì chōu yī tiān lái kàn nǐ de
sents.en: I'll come and see you one of these days.

sents.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
sents.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
sents.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

sents.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shàng xíng zǒu ma
sents.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

sents.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
sents.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

sents.zh: 你还以为我不需要那么做，不是吗？
sents.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ bù xū yào nà me zuò bù shì ma
sents.en: You thought I didn't need to do that, didn't you?

sents.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。
sents.p: nǐ huì xū yào yī gè tè shū de gōng jù lái zuò zhè jiàn shì
sents.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.

sents.zh: 你具体需要些什么？
sents.p: nǐ jù tǐ xū yào xiē shén me
sents.en: What do you need exactly?

sents.zh: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
sents.p: rú guǒ tā nián qīng yī diǎn tā jiāng hěn shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi
sents.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.

sents.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
sents.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

sents.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
sents.p: yī gè yǒu míng de jiàn zhù shī zào le zhè gè fáng zi
sents.en: A famous architect built this house.

sents.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
sents.p: zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
sents.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

sents.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
sents.p: dà zì rán zài wǒ men de shēng huó zhōng bàn yǎn zhuó zhòng yào de jué sè
sents.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.

sents.zh: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。
sents.p: tā yǐ jīng wú fǎ yòng yǔ yán biǎo dá tā de gǎn jué le
sents.en: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.

sents.zh: 你想表达什么？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng biǎo dá shén me
sents.en: What do you mean?

sents.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shàng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
sents.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

sents.zh: 人们认为，他完全能胜任这个工作。
sents.p: rén men rèn wéi tā wán quán néng shèng rèn zhè gè gōng zuò
sents.en: He was considered very qualified for the job.

sents.zh: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。
sents.p: wǒ ài nǐ shèng guò qí tā rèn hé yī gè rén
sents.en: I love you more than anyone else.

sents.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。
sents.p: wǒ bù néng què bǎo zhè yī qiè huì fā shēng
sents.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.

sents.zh: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
sents.p: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé
sents.en: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.

sents.zh: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me bǎ nǐ xīn jiàn de fáng zi mài le
sents.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?

sents.zh: 我建议，为了礼貌起见，我们尽可能少喝。
sents.p: wǒ jiàn yì wèi le lǐ mào qǐ jiàn wǒ men jǐn kě néng shǎo hē
sents.en: I suggest we drink as little as possible to be polite.

sents.zh: 你年龄足够大了，该了解更多。
sents.p: nǐ nián líng zú gòu dà le gāi liǎo jiě gēng duō
sents.en: You're old enough to know better.

sents.zh: 我们没有足够的时间来完成手头的工作。
sents.p: wǒ men méi yǒu zú gòu de shí jiān lái wán chéng shǒu tóu de gōng zuò
sents.en: We didn't have enough time to finish what we were doing.

sents.zh: 我们知道我们的权利。
sents.p: wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì
sents.en: We know our rights.

sents.zh: 他应该有权利去自己做决定。
sents.p: tā yīng gāi yǒu quán lì qù zì jǐ zuò jué dìng
sents.en: He should have the right to decide for himself.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

items.en: to adopt or carry out; to take

ex.zh: 他们根据情报采取行动。
ex.p: tā men gēn jù qíng bào cǎi qǔ xíng dòng
ex.en: They acted on the information.

ex.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
ex.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 在我的邻近区域有一个大超市。
ex.p: zài wǒ de lín jìn qū yù yǒu yī gè dà chāo shì
ex.en: There's a big supermarket in my neighborhood.

ex.zh: 这片区域很少下雪。
ex.p: zhè piàn qū yù hěn shǎo xià xuě
ex.en: It rarely snows in this area.

ex.zh: 他旅行期间，写了旅游日记。
ex.p: tā lǚ xíng qī jiān xiě le lǚ yóu rì jì
ex.en: He kept a diary during the trip.

ex.zh: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。
ex.p: tā xiū jià qī jiān huā le yī dà bǐ qián
ex.en: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.

ex.zh: 他在工作中出了意外。
ex.p: tā zài gōng zuò zhōng chū le yì wài
ex.en: He had an accident at work.

ex.zh: 这真是很意外。
ex.p: zhè zhēn shì hěn yì wài
ex.en: That is rather unexpected.

ex.zh: 我不想承担这样一个风险。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng chéng dān zhè yàng yī gè fēng xiǎn
ex.en: I don't want to take such a risk.

ex.zh: 我不担心风险。
ex.p: wǒ bù dān xīn fēng xiǎn
ex.en: I don't worry about the risk.

ex.zh: 这是一个伟大的时刻。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè wěi dà de shí kè
ex.en: This is a great moment.

ex.zh: 我们的方案在最后的时刻失败了。
ex.p: wǒ men de fāng àn zài zuì hòu de shí kè shī bài le
ex.en: Our plans fell through at the last minute.

ex.zh: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。
ex.p: tā jī hū méi yǒu shuō wán huà jiù bèi tā dǎ duàn le
ex.en: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.

ex.zh: 他打断了我们的谈论。
ex.p: tā dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán lùn
ex.en: He interrupted our conversation.

ex.zh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
ex.p: wǒ men de jiū jí mù biāo shì shù lì shì jiè hé píng
ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.

ex.zh: 你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。
ex.p: nǐ běn gāi jù jué yī gè nà me bù gōng píng de tí yì
ex.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.

items.en: to observe; to watch; to survey

ex.zh: 观察鸟类是个很好的业余爱好。
ex.p: guān chá niǎo lèi shì gè hěn hǎo de yè yú ài hào
ex.en: Bird watching is a nice hobby.

ex.zh: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。
ex.p: shì qing méi néng rú tā suǒ yuàn ràng tā gǎn dào shī wàng
ex.en: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.

ex.zh: 他更愿意工作而不是无所事事。
ex.p: tā gēng yuàn yì gōng zuò ér bù shì wú suǒ shì shì
ex.en: He preferred working to doing nothing.

ex.zh: 我觉得这难以置信。
ex.p: wǒ jué de zhè nán yǐ zhì xìn
ex.en: It is hard for me to believe this.

ex.zh: 那有点难以置信。
ex.p: nà yǒu diǎn nán yǐ zhì xìn
ex.en: That's a little hard to believe.

items.en: to approach; to get close to

ex.zh: 我们无法接近敌人。
ex.p: wǒ men wú fǎ jiē jìn dí rén
ex.en: We can't get close to the enemy.

ex.zh: 总统很难接近。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng hěn nán jiē jìn
ex.en: The president is difficult to approach.

ex.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
ex.p: diàn huà yùn yíng shāng tí shì lái diàn rén děng hòu jiē tōng
ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

ex.zh: 有些人喜欢运动，有些人不喜欢。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén xǐ huan yùn dòng yǒu xiē rén bù xǐ huan
ex.en: Some people like sports, and others don't.

ex.zh: 今日的朋友是明日的敌人。
ex.p: jīn rì de péng you shì míng rì de dí rén
ex.en: Today's friends are tomorrow's enemies.

ex.zh: 你是你自己最大的敌人。
ex.p: nǐ shì nǐ zì jǐ zuì dà de dí rén
ex.en: You're your own worst enemy.

ex.zh: 不只是钱关系重大。
ex.p: bù zhǐ shì qián guān xi zhòng dà
ex.en: Money isn't the only thing that matters.

items.en: to make clear; to make known

ex.zh: 她是个女程序员吗？
ex.p: tā shì gè nǚ chéng xù yuán ma
ex.en: Is she a computer programmer?

ex.zh: 我想做一个程序员。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zuò yī gè chéng xù yuán
ex.en: I want to be a computer programmer.

ex.zh: 雪从明天开始下，一直持续一个星期。
ex.p: xuě cóng míng tiān kāi shǐ xià yī zhí chí xù yī gè xīng qī
ex.en: Starting tomorrow, it's going to snow for a week.

ex.zh: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。
ex.p: zhè chǎng jiǎn jià huó dòng huì chí xù sān tiān cóng jīn tiān kāi shǐ
ex.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.

ex.zh: 热情具有传染性。
ex.p: rè qíng jù yǒu chuán rǎn xìng
ex.en: Enthusiasm is contagious.

HSK 5 · 第76单元

sents.zh: 我现在仅有的东西就是我的记忆了。
sents.p: wǒ xiàn zài jǐn yǒu de dōng xi jiù shì wǒ de jì yì le
sents.en: The only thing I have now are memories.

sents.zh: 我们需要更多员工。
sents.p: wǒ men xū yào gēng duō yuán gōng
sents.en: We need more staff.

sents.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
sents.p: rú hé kè fú rì yuán shēng gāo shì gè dà wèn tí
sents.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.

sents.zh: 太阳从东边升起，西边落下。
sents.p: tài yang cóng dōng bian shēng qǐ xī biān luò xià
sents.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

sents.zh: 他的父母经营一家酒店。
sents.p: tā de fù mǔ jīng yíng yī jiā jiǔ diàn
sents.en: His parents ran a hotel.

sents.zh: 我当初要是买音乐会的票就好了。
sents.p: wǒ dāng chū yào shi mǎi yīn yuè huì de piào jiù hǎo le
sents.en: I wish I had bought a ticket for the concert.

sents.zh: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。
sents.p: běn shì jì chū yǐ lái chǎn shēng le hěn duō jìn bù
sents.en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.

sents.zh: 发挥您的想象力。
sents.p: fā huī nín de xiǎng xiàng lì
sents.en: Use your imagination.

sents.zh: 你认为他是自己独立完成这份工的吗？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi tā shì zì jǐ dú lì wán chéng zhè fèn gōng de ma
sents.en: Do you think he did the job on his own?

sents.zh: 你必须独立完成。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū dú lì wán chéng
sents.en: You have to do it by yourself.

sents.zh: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。
sents.p: yào wán chéng shí yàn sān gè yuè tài duǎn le
sents.en: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.

sents.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。
sents.p: shí yàn shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le

units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

ex.zh: 人们通常不喜欢他们不理解的事物。
ex.p: rén men tōng cháng bù xǐ huan tā men bù lǐ jiě de shì wù

ex.zh: 我通常星期天要到中午才起床。

ex.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

ex.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

items.en: on the eve of; to be about to

ex.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。

ex.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

ex.zh: 我的宝宝开始哭了，他想要吃奶。
ex.p: wǒ de bǎo bao kāi shǐ kū le tā xiǎng yào chī nǎi
ex.en: My baby began crying, asking for milk.

ex.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
ex.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shàng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xi
ex.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

ex.zh: 我们很遗憾没能帮助你们。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn yí hàn méi néng bāng zhù nǐ men
ex.en: We are sorry we can't help you.

ex.zh: 有人死了的时候真是遗憾。
ex.p: yǒu rén sǐ le de shí hou zhēn shì yí hàn
ex.en: It's a pity when somebody dies.

ex.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
ex.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

ex.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan xué xí bù guī zé dòng cí

ex.zh: 请问在欧洲最高的山是哪儿呢？

ex.zh: 去哪里可以买到欧洲的地图？
ex.p: qù nǎ lǐ kě yǐ mǎi dào oū zhōu de dì tú

ex.zh: 他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。

ex.zh: 这个价格不合理。
ex.p: zhè gè jià gé bù hé lǐ

ex.zh: 你依然和父母住一起吗？

items.en: mature; ripe; to mature; to ripen

ex.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

ex.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.

ex.zh: 我和他们意见一致。
ex.p: wǒ hé tā men yì jiàn yī zhì
ex.en: I think the same as they do.

ex.zh: 选举一致通过了。

ex.en: The vote is unanimous.

items.en: to trust; to have confidence in

ex.zh: 你们除了信任对方，没什么要做的了。

ex.zh: 你是我唯一可以信任的人。

ex.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？
ex.p: nǐ jīn nián zuò de zuì cì jī de shì shì shén me

ex.zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
ex.p: qǐng bù yào wàng jì jì xìn qián yào zài shàng miàn tiē yóu piào
ex.en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.

ex.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。
ex.p: bié wàng le zài nǐ de xìn shàng tiē zhāng yóu piào
ex.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.

items.en: as quickly as possible; as soon as possible

ex.zh: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。
ex.p: shōu dào cǐ yóu jiàn hòu qǐng jǐn kuài gěi wǒ dá fù
ex.en: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.

ex.zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
ex.en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 将你需要的药物写在这张纸上。

ex.en: Write down the medicine you need on this piece of paper.

ex.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
ex.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

items.en: to go a step further; more; further

ex.zh: 谁负责销售部门？
ex.p: shéi fù zé xiāo shòu bù mén
ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?

ex.zh: 今年销售会翻番。
ex.p: jīn nián xiāo shòu huì fān fān
ex.en: Sales should double this year.

ex.zh: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
ex.p: wǒ néng wén dào tā hū xī zhōng de jiǔ jīng wèi
ex.en: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

ex.zh: 我的鼻子没办法呼吸了。
ex.p: wǒ de bí zi méi bàn fǎ hū xī le
ex.en: I can't breathe through my nose.

items.en: to sell; to offer for sale

ex.zh: 这房子不出售。
ex.p: zhè fáng zi bù chū shòu
ex.en: This house isn't for sale.

ex.zh: 我该用短一点的用户名的。
ex.p: wǒ gāi yòng duǎn yī diǎn de yòng hù míng de
ex.en: I should've chosen a shorter username.

ex.zh: 我想不到好的用户名
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng bù dào hǎo de yòng hù míng
ex.en: I can't think of a good username.

ex.zh: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
ex.p: nǐ gū jì zuò nà jiàn shì xū yào huā fèi nǐ duō shǎo shí jiān ne
ex.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?

ex.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
ex.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

items.en: to deposit money (in a bank etc); bank savings

ex.zh: 你们什么时候开始营业？
ex.p: nǐ men shén me shí hou kāi shǐ yíng yè
ex.en: What time do you open?

ex.zh: 银行星期六不营业。
ex.p: yín háng xīng qī liù bù yíng yè
ex.en: The bank is not open on Saturdays.

items.en: preferably; one would prefer to...(or not to...)
to appreciate (in value); to increase in price
rather than...; 与其 A 如 B

ex.zh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
ex.p: yǔ qí ràng wǒ zài tā shǒu xià gàn wǒ nìng yuàn cí zhí
ex.en: I would rather quit than work under him.

sents.en: I can't breathe through my nose.

sents.zh: 这房子不出售。
sents.p: zhè fáng zi bù chū shòu
sents.en: This house isn't for sale.

sents.zh: 我该用短一点的用户名的。
sents.p: wǒ gāi yòng duǎn yī diǎn de yòng hù míng de
sents.en: I should've chosen a shorter username.

sents.zh: 我想不到好的用户名
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng bù dào hǎo de yòng hù míng
sents.en: I can't think of a good username.

sents.zh: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
sents.p: nǐ gū jì zuò nà jiàn shì xū yào huā fèi nǐ duō shǎo shí jiān ne
sents.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?

sents.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
sents.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
sents.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

sents.zh: 你们什么时候开始营业？
sents.p: nǐ men shén me shí hou kāi shǐ yíng yè
sents.en: What time do you open?

sents.zh: 银行星期六不营业。
sents.p: yín háng xīng qī liù bù yíng yè
sents.en: The bank is not open on Saturdays.

sents.zh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
sents.p: yǔ qí ràng wǒ zài tā shǒu xià gàn wǒ nìng yuàn cí zhí
sents.en: I would rather quit than work under him.

ex.zh: 我知道，我做了很可怕的事。

ex.en: This is a terrible mistake.

ex.zh: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。
ex.p: chū qù zhī qián què rèn yī xià suǒ yǒu de dēng dōu guān le

ex.zh: 软件正在不断进化。

ex.zh: 他不是那么出色的作家我想他知道这一点。

ex.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
ex.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā

ex.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

ex.zh: 她沉迷于摇滚乐。

ex.zh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。

ex.zh: 我也有权讲话。

ex.en: I have the right to speak, too.

ex.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

ex.zh: 我随时可以开始。

ex.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
ex.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn

ex.zh: 祝你下一次好运。
ex.p: zhù nǐ xià yī cì hǎo yùn
ex.en: Better luck next time.

ex.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
ex.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.

ex.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ gāi chī huǒ tuǐ sān míng zhì
ex.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.

ex.zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。
ex.p: wǒ men shǐ yòng le qiáng dà de cuò shī lái yù fáng
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
ex.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
ex.p: tā shì gè fù yǒu cái néng de nián qīng dǎo yǎn
ex.en: He's a talented young director.

ex.zh: 他为自己的利益行事。
ex.p: tā wèi zì jǐ de lì yì xíng shì
ex.en: He is acting on his own behalf.

ex.zh: 他只顾自己的利益。
ex.p: tā zhǐ gù zì jǐ de lì yì
ex.en: All he thinks about is himself.

ex.zh: 这博物馆里面没有活的生物。
ex.p: zhè bó wù guǎn lǐ miàn méi yǒu huó de shēng wù
ex.en: There are no live animals in the museum.

ex.zh: 他是一个生物学家。
ex.p: tā shì yī gè shēng wù xué jiā
ex.en: He's a biologist.

ex.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
ex.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
ex.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

ex.zh: 我迷路了，能不能请您帮我一下？
ex.p: wǒ mí lù le néng bù néng qǐng nín bāng wǒ yī xià
ex.en: I am lost. Can you help me, please?

ex.zh: 不论去哪，我都会迷路。
ex.p: bù lùn qù nǎ wǒ dū huì mí lù
ex.en: No matter where I go, I get lost.

ex.zh: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。
ex.p: lìng wǒ chī jīng de shì tā hěn róng yì jiù xiǎng chū le yī gè fāng àn
ex.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.

ex.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
ex.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè dào qiàn
ex.en: You owe me an apology for that.

ex.zh: 你欠我一个人情。
ex.p: nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè rén qíng
ex.en: You owe me a favor.

ex.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
ex.p: tā zuì hòu yī běn xiǎo shuō de zhǔ tí shì shén me
ex.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?

ex.zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tā huì duì shén me zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?

ex.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
ex.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
ex.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

ex.zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi bù xī dài jià bì miǎn zhàn zhēng
ex.en: We must avoid war at all cost.

ex.zh: 我宁愿避免这种事。
ex.p: wǒ nìng yuàn bì miǎn zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I'd rather avoid it.

ex.zh: 日本生产很多好相机。
ex.p: rì běn shēng chǎn hěn duō hǎo xiàng jī
ex.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.

ex.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
ex.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shàng
ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

ex.zh: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
ex.p: zhè wèi lǎo shī yòng shì yàn lùn zhèng le zhè gè xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

ex.zh: 他们一直闹笑话。
ex.p: tā men yī zhí nào xiào hua
ex.en: They were always making jokes.

ex.zh: 她在无理取闹。
ex.p: tā zài wú lǐ qǔ nào
ex.en: She's asking for the impossible.

ex.zh: 人类是唯一能够彼此交谈的动物。
ex.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī néng gòu bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that can talk.

ex.zh: 人类是唯一彼此交谈的动物。
ex.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that talks.

ex.zh: 我强力推荐它。
ex.p: wǒ qiáng lì tuī jiàn tā
ex.en: I recommend it strongly.

ex.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
ex.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
ex.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

ex.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
ex.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shàng
ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

ex.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
ex.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

ex.zh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
ex.p: wǒ de lù xiàng jī kě yǐ pāi gāo qīng shì pín
ex.en: My camera can shoot high-definition video.

ex.zh: 我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng wǒ men lù yòng le nǐ lái dān rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò
ex.en: I'm glad we hired you for this job.

items.en: nice surprise; to be pleasantly surprised

ex.zh: 为什么任何人应该感到惊喜？
ex.p: wèi shén me rèn hé rén yīng gāi gǎn dào jīng xǐ
ex.en: Why should anyone be surprised?

ex.zh: 这是一个惊喜。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jīng xǐ
ex.en: It's a surprise.

ex.zh: 这朵花散发出强烈的香味。
ex.p: zhè duǒ huā sàn fā chū qiáng liè de xiāng wèi
ex.en: This flower gives off a strong fragrance.

sents.en: Better luck next time.

sents.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
sents.p: yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
sents.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.

sents.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ gāi chī huǒ tuǐ sān míng zhì
sents.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.

sents.zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。
sents.p: wǒ men shǐ yòng le qiáng dà de cuò shī lái yù fáng
sents.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

sents.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
sents.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
sents.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

sents.zh: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
sents.p: tā shì gè fù yǒu cái néng de nián qīng dǎo yǎn
sents.en: He's a talented young director.

sents.zh: 他为自己的利益行事。
sents.p: tā wèi zì jǐ de lì yì xíng shì
sents.en: He is acting on his own behalf.

sents.zh: 他只顾自己的利益。
sents.p: tā zhǐ gù zì jǐ de lì yì
sents.en: All he thinks about is himself.

sents.zh: 这博物馆里面没有活的生物。
sents.p: zhè bó wù guǎn lǐ miàn méi yǒu huó de shēng wù
sents.en: There are no live animals in the museum.

sents.zh: 他是一个生物学家。
sents.p: tā shì yī gè shēng wù xué jiā
sents.en: He's a biologist.

sents.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
sents.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
sents.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

sents.zh: 我迷路了，能不能请您帮我一下？
sents.p: wǒ mí lù le néng bù néng qǐng nín bāng wǒ yī xià
sents.en: I am lost. Can you help me, please?

sents.zh: 不论去哪，我都会迷路。
sents.p: bù lùn qù nǎ wǒ dū huì mí lù
sents.en: No matter where I go, I get lost.

sents.zh: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。
sents.p: lìng wǒ chī jīng de shì tā hěn róng yì jiù xiǎng chū le yī gè fāng àn
sents.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.

sents.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
sents.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè dào qiàn
sents.en: You owe me an apology for that.

sents.zh: 你欠我一个人情。
sents.p: nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè rén qíng
sents.en: You owe me a favor.

sents.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
sents.p: tā zuì hòu yī běn xiǎo shuō de zhǔ tí shì shén me
sents.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?

sents.zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
sents.p: nǐ jué de tā huì duì shén me zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?

sents.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
sents.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
sents.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

sents.zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi bù xī dài jià bì miǎn zhàn zhēng
sents.en: We must avoid war at all cost.

sents.zh: 我宁愿避免这种事。
sents.p: wǒ nìng yuàn bì miǎn zhè zhǒng shì
sents.en: I'd rather avoid it.

sents.zh: 日本生产很多好相机。
sents.p: rì běn shēng chǎn hěn duō hǎo xiàng jī
sents.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.

sents.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
sents.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shàng
sents.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

sents.zh: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
sents.p: zhè wèi lǎo shī yòng shì yàn lùn zhèng le zhè gè xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

sents.zh: 他们一直闹笑话。
sents.p: tā men yī zhí nào xiào hua
sents.en: They were always making jokes.

sents.zh: 她在无理取闹。
sents.p: tā zài wú lǐ qǔ nào
sents.en: She's asking for the impossible.

sents.zh: 人类是唯一能够彼此交谈的动物。
sents.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī néng gòu bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
sents.en: Man is the only animal that can talk.

sents.zh: 人类是唯一彼此交谈的动物。
sents.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
sents.en: Man is the only animal that talks.

sents.zh: 我强力推荐它。
sents.p: wǒ qiáng lì tuī jiàn tā
sents.en: I recommend it strongly.

sents.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
sents.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
sents.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

sents.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
sents.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
sents.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

sents.zh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
sents.p: wǒ de lù xiàng jī kě yǐ pāi gāo qīng shì pín
sents.en: My camera can shoot high-definition video.

sents.zh: 我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。
sents.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng wǒ men lù yòng le nǐ lái dān rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò
sents.en: I'm glad we hired you for this job.

sents.zh: 为什么任何人应该感到惊喜？
sents.p: wèi shén me rèn hé rén yīng gāi gǎn dào jīng xǐ
sents.en: Why should anyone be surprised?

sents.zh: 这是一个惊喜。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè jīng xǐ
sents.en: It's a surprise.

sents.zh: 这朵花散发出强烈的香味。
sents.p: zhè duǒ huā sàn fā chū qiáng liè de xiāng wèi
sents.en: This flower gives off a strong fragrance.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

items.en: to fight for; to strive for

ex.zh: 你认为那公平吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi nà gōng píng ma
ex.en: Do you think that was fair?

ex.zh: 那是不公平的。
ex.p: nà shì bù gōng píng de
ex.en: That's not fair.

ex.zh: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”
ex.p: dòng lǐ fā shēng le shén me wǒ hěn hào qí wǒ yī diǎn yě bù zhī dào
ex.en: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."

ex.zh: 你的袜子破了一个洞呀。
ex.p: nǐ de wà zi pò le yī gè dòng ya
ex.en: There is a hole in your sock.

ex.zh: 我今天早晨感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo chén gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I'm feeling good this morning.

ex.zh: 我今晚感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn wǎn gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I felt good tonight.

items.en: to reflect on; to ponder over

ex.zh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。
ex.p: zhēn zhèng de kē xué jiā bù huì zhè yàng qù sī kǎo
ex.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.

ex.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
ex.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
ex.en: He was meditating on his future life.

ex.zh: 来抽签决定谁先走吧。
ex.p: lái chōu qiān jué dìng shéi xiān zǒu ba
ex.en: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.

ex.zh: 别用铅笔签合同。
ex.p: bié yòng qiān bǐ qiān hé tong
ex.en: Don't sign the contract in pencil.

ex.zh: 自从他离开去法国，已经有两个月了。
ex.p: zì cóng tā lí kāi qù fǎ guó yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng gè yuè le
ex.en: Two months have passed since he left for France.

ex.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
ex.p: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu wǒ fù qīn yī zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài
ex.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

ex.zh: 如果你尝试的话，你会成功的。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ cháng shì de huà nǐ huì chéng gōng de
ex.en: You'll succeed if you try.

ex.zh: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。
ex.p: wú lùn wǒ duō me nǔ lì cháng shì wǒ dōu wú fǎ zuò dào bǐ tā gēng hǎo
ex.en: However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.

ex.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
ex.p: nǐ cái shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ rén
ex.en: You're the master of your own destiny.

ex.zh: 她该接受她的命运。
ex.p: tā gāi jiē shòu tā de mìng yùn
ex.en: She had to accept her fate.

ex.zh: 数千人受此疾病所害。
ex.p: shù qiān rén shòu cǐ jí bìng suǒ hài
ex.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.

ex.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
ex.p: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng
ex.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

ex.zh: 她上女子高中。
ex.p: tā shàng nǚ zǐ gāo zhōng
ex.en: She goes to a girls' high school.

ex.zh: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
ex.p: wǒ yě tīng guò yī gè lèi sì de gù shì
ex.en: I also heard a similar story.

ex.zh: 你的问题类似于我的。
ex.p: nǐ de wèn tí lèi sì yú wǒ de
ex.en: Your problem is similar to mine.

items.en: to lean against; to rely on

ex.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
ex.p: zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
ex.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.

ex.zh: 我凭什么花时间做这事？
ex.p: wǒ píng shén me huā shí jiān zuò zhè shì
ex.en: Why should I take the time to do that?

items.en: as much as possible; to the greatest extent

ex.zh: “你明天会来我的聚会吗？”“我尽量来。”
ex.p: nǐ míng tiān huì lái wǒ de jù huì ma wǒ jǐn liàng lái
ex.en: "Will you be at my party tomorrow night?" "I'll try to be there."

ex.zh: 请您能不能尽量慢点说？
ex.p: qǐng nín néng bù néng jǐn liàng màn diǎn shuō
ex.en: Please speak as slowly as possible.

ex.zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。
ex.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ chī wǔ fàn jiù yào chí dào le
ex.en: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.

ex.zh: 快点，不然要赶不上火车了。
ex.p: kuài diǎn bù rán yào gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē le
ex.en: Be quick, or you will miss the train.

ex.zh: 你有资格知道。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zī gé zhī dào
ex.en: You have the right to know.

ex.zh: 这是个企业生活区。
ex.p: zhè shì gè qǐ yè shēng huó qū
ex.en: This is a company town.

ex.zh: 这些工具是用来造房子的。
ex.p: zhè xiē gōng jù shì yòng lái zào fáng zi de
ex.en: These tools are used for building a house.

items.en: to pursue (a goal etc) stubbornly; to seek after

ex.zh: 有些人只追求快乐。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén zhǐ zhuī qiú kuài lè
ex.en: Some people pursue only pleasure.

items.en: to appreciate; to enjoy; to admire
to carry on a shoulder pole; to choose

ex.zh: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì tiāo bié ren de máo bìng
ex.en: He is constantly finding fault with other people.

ex.zh: 我挑不出他的毛病。
ex.p: wǒ tiāo bù chū tā de máo bìng
ex.en: I cannot find fault with him.

ex.zh: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。
ex.p: tā bǎ bēi zi diào dào dì bǎn shàng dǎ suì le
ex.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.

ex.zh: 她把信成碎片。
ex.p: tā bǎ xìn chéng suì piàn
ex.en: She tore the letter into pieces.

ex.zh: 没什么能阻止你出发了。
ex.p: méi shén me néng zǔ zhǐ nǐ chū fā le
ex.en: There's nothing to prevent you from going.

ex.zh: 你为什么不阻止他们？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me bù zǔ zhǐ tā men
ex.en: Why didn't you stop them?

ex.zh: 她老公现居东京。
ex.p: tā lǎo gōng xiàn jū dōng jīng
ex.en: Her husband is currently living in Tokyo.

ex.zh: 给我老公打电话。
ex.p: gěi wǒ lǎo gōng dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: Call my husband.

ex.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。
ex.p: hù lián wǎng shì yī zhǒng wú fǎ gū liàng de xìn xī zī yuán
ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.

ex.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。
ex.p: měi guó de zì rán zī yuán hěn fēng fù
ex.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.

ex.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
ex.p: tā shòu yāo zuò jù lè bù de zhǔ xí
ex.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.

ex.zh: 谁将当选主席呢？
ex.p: shéi jiāng dāng xuǎn zhǔ xí ne
ex.en: Who'll be elected chairman?

ex.zh: 下车，把手放在背后。
ex.p: xià chē bǎ shou fàng zài bèi hòu
ex.en: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.

ex.zh: 那背后是什么意思？
ex.p: nà bèi hòu shì shén me yì si
ex.en: What's the idea behind that?

ex.zh: 他在他弟弟旁边显得很年轻。
ex.p: tā zài tā dì di páng biān xiǎn de hěn nián qīng
ex.en: He looked young beside his brother.

ex.zh: 我们小时候，所有的一切对我们来说都显得那么大。。。
ex.p: wǒ men xiǎo shí hou suǒ yǒu de yī qiè duì wǒ men lái shuō dōu xiǎn de nà me dà
ex.en: When we're children, everything around us looks so big.

ex.zh: 父母承担教育子女的责任。
ex.p: fù mǔ chéng dān jiào yù zǐ nǚ de zé rèn
ex.en: Parents are responsible for their children's education.

ex.zh: 我准备好了承担后果。
ex.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le chéng dān hòu guǒ
ex.en: I'm prepared to accept the consequences.

items.en: to face sth; to be confronted with

ex.zh: 自然充满了神秘。
ex.p: zì rán chōng mǎn le shén mì
ex.en: Nature is full of mysteries.

ex.zh: 自动售货机在那边。
ex.p: zì dòng shòu huò jī zài nà bian
ex.en: The vending machines are over there.

ex.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng
ex.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

ex.zh: 我不得不在树下躲雨。
ex.p: wǒ bù dé bù zài shù xià duǒ yù
ex.en: I had to take shelter under a tree.

ex.zh: 跑到山里躲起来。
ex.p: pǎo dào shān lǐ duǒ qǐ lai
ex.en: Run and hide in the mountains.

ex.zh: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
ex.p: shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán
ex.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

HSK 5 · 第79单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.

sents.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
sents.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
sents.en: He was meditating on his future life.

sents.zh: 来抽签决定谁先走吧。
sents.p: lái chōu qiān jué dìng shéi xiān zǒu ba
sents.en: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.

sents.zh: 别用铅笔签合同。
sents.p: bié yòng qiān bǐ qiān hé tong
sents.en: Don't sign the contract in pencil.

sents.zh: 自从他离开去法国，已经有两个月了。
sents.p: zì cóng tā lí kāi qù fǎ guó yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng gè yuè le
sents.en: Two months have passed since he left for France.

sents.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
sents.p: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu wǒ fù qīn yī zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài
sents.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

sents.zh: 如果你尝试的话，你会成功的。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ cháng shì de huà nǐ huì chéng gōng de
sents.en: You'll succeed if you try.

sents.zh: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。
sents.p: wú lùn wǒ duō me nǔ lì cháng shì wǒ dōu wú fǎ zuò dào bǐ tā gēng hǎo
sents.en: However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.

sents.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
sents.p: nǐ cái shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ rén
sents.en: You're the master of your own destiny.

sents.zh: 她该接受她的命运。
sents.p: tā gāi jiē shòu tā de mìng yùn
sents.en: She had to accept her fate.

sents.zh: 数千人受此疾病所害。
sents.p: shù qiān rén shòu cǐ jí bìng suǒ hài
sents.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.

sents.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
sents.p: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng
sents.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

sents.zh: 她上女子高中。
sents.p: tā shàng nǚ zǐ gāo zhōng
sents.en: She goes to a girls' high school.

sents.zh: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
sents.p: wǒ yě tīng guò yī gè lèi sì de gù shì
sents.en: I also heard a similar story.

sents.zh: 你的问题类似于我的。
sents.p: nǐ de wèn tí lèi sì yú wǒ de
sents.en: Your problem is similar to mine.

sents.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
sents.p: zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
sents.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.

sents.zh: 我凭什么花时间做这事？
sents.p: wǒ píng shén me huā shí jiān zuò zhè shì
sents.en: Why should I take the time to do that?

sents.zh: “你明天会来我的聚会吗？”“我尽量来。”
sents.p: nǐ míng tiān huì lái wǒ de jù huì ma wǒ jǐn liàng lái
sents.en: "Will you be at my party tomorrow night?" "I'll try to be there."

sents.zh: 请您能不能尽量慢点说？
sents.p: qǐng nín néng bù néng jǐn liàng màn diǎn shuō
sents.en: Please speak as slowly as possible.

sents.zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。
sents.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ chī wǔ fàn jiù yào chí dào le
sents.en: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.

sents.zh: 快点，不然要赶不上火车了。
sents.p: kuài diǎn bù rán yào gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē le
sents.en: Be quick, or you will miss the train.

sents.zh: 你有资格知道。
sents.p: nǐ yǒu zī gé zhī dào
sents.en: You have the right to know.

sents.zh: 这是个企业生活区。
sents.p: zhè shì gè qǐ yè shēng huó qū
sents.en: This is a company town.

sents.zh: 这些工具是用来造房子的。
sents.p: zhè xiē gōng jù shì yòng lái zào fáng zi de
sents.en: These tools are used for building a house.

sents.zh: 有些人只追求快乐。
sents.p: yǒu xiē rén zhǐ zhuī qiú kuài lè
sents.en: Some people pursue only pleasure.

sents.zh: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
sents.p: tā zǒng shì tiāo bié ren de máo bìng
sents.en: He is constantly finding fault with other people.

sents.zh: 我挑不出他的毛病。
sents.p: wǒ tiāo bù chū tā de máo bìng
sents.en: I cannot find fault with him.

sents.zh: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。
sents.p: tā bǎ bēi zi diào dào dì bǎn shàng dǎ suì le
sents.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.

sents.zh: 她把信成碎片。
sents.p: tā bǎ xìn chéng suì piàn
sents.en: She tore the letter into pieces.

sents.zh: 没什么能阻止你出发了。
sents.p: méi shén me néng zǔ zhǐ nǐ chū fā le
sents.en: There's nothing to prevent you from going.

sents.zh: 你为什么不阻止他们？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me bù zǔ zhǐ tā men
sents.en: Why didn't you stop them?

sents.zh: 她老公现居东京。
sents.p: tā lǎo gōng xiàn jū dōng jīng
sents.en: Her husband is currently living in Tokyo.

sents.zh: 给我老公打电话。
sents.p: gěi wǒ lǎo gōng dǎ diàn huà
sents.en: Call my husband.

sents.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。
sents.p: hù lián wǎng shì yī zhǒng wú fǎ gū liàng de xìn xī zī yuán
sents.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.

sents.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。
sents.p: měi guó de zì rán zī yuán hěn fēng fù
sents.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.

sents.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
sents.p: tā shòu yāo zuò jù lè bù de zhǔ xí
sents.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.

sents.zh: 谁将当选主席呢？
sents.p: shéi jiāng dāng xuǎn zhǔ xí ne
sents.en: Who'll be elected chairman?

sents.zh: 下车，把手放在背后。
sents.p: xià chē bǎ shou fàng zài bèi hòu
sents.en: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.

sents.zh: 那背后是什么意思？
sents.p: nà bèi hòu shì shén me yì si
sents.en: What's the idea behind that?

sents.zh: 他在他弟弟旁边显得很年轻。
sents.p: tā zài tā dì di páng biān xiǎn de hěn nián qīng
sents.en: He looked young beside his brother.

sents.zh: 我们小时候，所有的一切对我们来说都显得那么大。。。
sents.p: wǒ men xiǎo shí hou suǒ yǒu de yī qiè duì wǒ men lái shuō dōu xiǎn de nà me dà
sents.en: When we're children, everything around us looks so big.

sents.zh: 父母承担教育子女的责任。
sents.p: fù mǔ chéng dān jiào yù zǐ nǚ de zé rèn
sents.en: Parents are responsible for their children's education.

sents.zh: 我准备好了承担后果。
sents.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le chéng dān hòu guǒ
sents.en: I'm prepared to accept the consequences.

sents.zh: 自然充满了神秘。
sents.p: zì rán chōng mǎn le shén mì
sents.en: Nature is full of mysteries.

sents.zh: 自动售货机在那边。
sents.p: zì dòng shòu huò jī zài nà bian
sents.en: The vending machines are over there.

sents.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng
sents.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

sents.zh: 我不得不在树下躲雨。
sents.p: wǒ bù dé bù zài shù xià duǒ yù
sents.en: I had to take shelter under a tree.

sents.zh: 跑到山里躲起来。
sents.p: pǎo dào shān lǐ duǒ qǐ lai
sents.en: Run and hide in the mountains.

sents.zh: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
sents.p: shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán
sents.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 没有水，我们无法生存。
ex.p: méi yǒu shuǐ wǒ men wú fǎ shēng cún
ex.en: Without water, we cannot exist.

ex.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。
ex.p: yī shēng jiān chí bìng rén huò dé chōng fèn de xiū xi
ex.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.

ex.zh: 今晚我们有充分的时间。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ men yǒu chōng fèn de shí jiān
ex.en: We have plenty of time tonight.

ex.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。
ex.p: wǒ bù míng bai wèi shén me nǐ zhè me pī píng tā
ex.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

ex.zh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de míng zi jiā dào děng hòu pī zhǔn de shēn qǐng rén míng dān shàng ma
ex.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?

ex.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
ex.p: nǐ cái shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ rén
ex.en: You're the master of your own destiny.

ex.zh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
ex.p: bèi gào huì xiàng shàng jí fǎ yuàn shàng sù
ex.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.

ex.zh: 让我们一醉方休吧！
ex.p: ràng wǒ men yī zuì fāng xiū ba
ex.en: Let's get drunk.

ex.zh: 我喝醉了，做不到。
ex.p: wǒ hē zuì le zuò bù dào
ex.en: I'm too drunk to do that.

ex.zh: 妈妈想念她在读大学的女儿。
ex.p: mā ma xiǎng niàn tā zài dú dà xué de nǚ ér
ex.en: The mother missed her daughter who was away at college.

ex.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
ex.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

ex.zh: 我拒绝被像一个孩子般对待。
ex.p: wǒ jù jué bèi xiàng yī gè hái zi bān duì dài
ex.en: I refuse to be treated like a child.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢他怎么对待他人。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan tā zěn me duì dài tā rén
ex.en: I do not like the way he treats others.

items.en: or; either one or the other

ex.zh: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ ná dà de hé zi huò shì xiǎo de hé zi
ex.en: You may take either the big box or the small one.

ex.zh: 酸雨不是自然现象。
ex.p: suān yù bù shì zì rán xiàn xiàng
ex.en: Acid rain isn't a natural phenomenon.

ex.zh: 不要低估自己的实力。
ex.p: bù yào dī gū zì jǐ de shí lì
ex.en: Don't underestimate your own strength.

ex.zh: 他享有私人教学的特权。
ex.p: tā xiǎng yǒu sī rén jiào xué de tè quán
ex.en: He had the privilege of a private education.

items.en: the whole journey; all the way

ex.zh: 祝你一路平安。
ex.p: zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
ex.en: Have a safe trip.

ex.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
ex.p: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

ex.zh: 日本在某些领域赶上了美国。
ex.p: rì běn zài mǒu xiē lǐng yù gǎn shàng le měi guó
ex.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.

items.en: to piece together; to join together

ex.zh: 他为了孩子的幸福，拼命的工作。
ex.p: tā wèi le hái zi de xìng fú pīn mìng de gōng zuò
ex.en: He worked hard to make his child happy.

ex.zh: 可能你工作得太拼命？
ex.p: kě néng nǐ gōng zuò de tài pīn mìng
ex.en: Maybe you're working too hard.

ex.zh: 你必须积极主动。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū jī jí zhǔ dòng
ex.en: You have to be proactive.

ex.zh: 硬币是金属做的。
ex.p: yìng bì shì jīn shǔ zuò de
ex.en: Coins are made of metal.

ex.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！
ex.p: wǒ tīng shuō nǐ tōng guò le rù xué kǎo shì gōng xǐ nǐ le
ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!

items.en: just in case; if by any chance

ex.zh: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。
ex.p: wàn yī lái bù liǎo wǒ huì xiān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.

ex.zh: 万一我来晚的话，就别等我了。
ex.p: wàn yī wǒ lái wǎn de huà jiù bié děng wǒ le
ex.en: If by any chance I'm late, please don't wait for me.

ex.zh: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。
ex.p: qǐ chū tā yǐ wéi yīng yǔ hěn nán rú jīn tā jué de hěn jiǎn dān
ex.en: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.

ex.zh: 如今很多的货物都由飞机运送。
ex.p: rú jīn hěn duō de huò wù dōu yóu fēi jī yùn sòng
ex.en: Many goods are now transported by air.

items.en: to leave for; to proceed towards; to go to

ex.zh: 我不想独自前往。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng dú zì qián wǎng
ex.en: I don't want to go alone.

items.en: to part company; to split up

ex.zh: 我们想学一些日文歌曲。
ex.p: wǒ men xiǎng xué yī xiē rì wén gē qǔ
ex.en: We want to learn some Japanese songs.

ex.zh: 我们有个好极了的团队。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu gè hǎo jí le de tuán duì
ex.en: We have a great team.

ex.zh: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。
ex.p: xiàn dài kē xué jì shù ràng wǒ men de shēng huó gèng jiā shū shì
ex.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.

ex.zh: 他学习现代文学。
ex.p: tā xué xí xiàn dài wén xué
ex.en: He studies contemporary literature.

ex.zh: 你在东京如何维持生计？
ex.p: nǐ zài dōng jīng rú hé wéi chí shēng jì
ex.en: How did you make a living in Tokyo?

ex.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
ex.p: zhè jǐ nián duì zuò yè liáo fǎ de xū qiú zài xùn sù zēng zhǎng
ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

ex.zh: 谢谢您的迅速回复。
ex.p: xiè xie nín de xùn sù huí fù
ex.en: Thanks for your quick answer.

ex.zh: 你说得你好像什么都知道似的。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de nǐ hǎo xiàng shén me dōu zhī dào shì de
ex.en: You talk as if you knew everything.

ex.zh: 死了就像做梦似的。
ex.p: sǐ le jiù xiàng zuò mèng shì de
ex.en: Death is like dreaming.

ex.zh: 我必须去睡觉了！我明天早上有课。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū qù shuì jiào le wǒ míng tiān zǎo shang yǒu kè
ex.en: I have to get to sleep! I've got classes tomorrow.

ex.zh: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè nǐ bì xū zì jǐ jiě jué de wèn tí
ex.en: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.

ex.zh: 许多男生和女生都出席了。
ex.p: xǔ duō nán shēng hé nǚ shēng dōu chū xí le
ex.en: Many boys and girls were present.

ex.zh: 全班同学每周出席一次。
ex.p: quán bān tóng xué měi zhōu chū xí yī cì
ex.en: The whole class is present once a week.

ex.zh: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de huà gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn kè de yìn xiàng
ex.en: What you said left a deep impression on me.

ex.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。
ex.p: yǎn jiǎng zhě jīng cǎi de yǎn shuō gěi wǒ men liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng
ex.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.

ex.zh: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
ex.p: nǐ néng zài wǒ men de hūn lǐ shàng chàng gē jiù tài hǎo le
ex.en: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.

ex.zh: 你出席了我的婚礼。
ex.p: nǐ chū xí le wǒ de hūn lǐ
ex.en: You were at my wedding.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第80单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 没有水，我们无法生存。
sents.p: méi yǒu shuǐ wǒ men wú fǎ shēng cún
sents.en: Without water, we cannot exist.

sents.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。
sents.p: yī shēng jiān chí bìng rén huò dé chōng fèn de xiū xi
sents.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.

sents.zh: 今晚我们有充分的时间。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ men yǒu chōng fèn de shí jiān
sents.en: We have plenty of time tonight.

sents.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。
sents.p: wǒ bù míng bai wèi shén me nǐ zhè me pī píng tā
sents.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

sents.zh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de míng zi jiā dào děng hòu pī zhǔn de shēn qǐng rén míng dān shàng ma
sents.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?

sents.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
sents.p: nǐ cái shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ rén
sents.en: You're the master of your own destiny.

sents.zh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
sents.p: bèi gào huì xiàng shàng jí fǎ yuàn shàng sù
sents.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.

sents.zh: 让我们一醉方休吧！
sents.p: ràng wǒ men yī zuì fāng xiū ba
sents.en: Let's get drunk.

sents.zh: 我喝醉了，做不到。
sents.p: wǒ hē zuì le zuò bù dào
sents.en: I'm too drunk to do that.

sents.zh: 妈妈想念她在读大学的女儿。
sents.p: mā ma xiǎng niàn tā zài dú dà xué de nǚ ér
sents.en: The mother missed her daughter who was away at college.

sents.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
sents.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

sents.zh: 我拒绝被像一个孩子般对待。
sents.p: wǒ jù jué bèi xiàng yī gè hái zi bān duì dài
sents.en: I refuse to be treated like a child.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢他怎么对待他人。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan tā zěn me duì dài tā rén
sents.en: I do not like the way he treats others.

sents.zh: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ ná dà de hé zi huò shì xiǎo de hé zi
sents.en: You may take either the big box or the small one.

sents.zh: 酸雨不是自然现象。
sents.p: suān yù bù shì zì rán xiàn xiàng
sents.en: Acid rain isn't a natural phenomenon.

sents.zh: 不要低估自己的实力。
sents.p: bù yào dī gū zì jǐ de shí lì
sents.en: Don't underestimate your own strength.

sents.zh: 他享有私人教学的特权。
sents.p: tā xiǎng yǒu sī rén jiào xué de tè quán
sents.en: He had the privilege of a private education.

sents.zh: 祝你一路平安。
sents.p: zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
sents.en: Have a safe trip.

sents.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 日本在某些领域赶上了美国。
sents.p: rì běn zài mǒu xiē lǐng yù gǎn shàng le měi guó
sents.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.

sents.zh: 他为了孩子的幸福，拼命的工作。
sents.p: tā wèi le hái zi de xìng fú pīn mìng de gōng zuò
sents.en: He worked hard to make his child happy.

sents.zh: 可能你工作得太拼命？
sents.p: kě néng nǐ gōng zuò de tài pīn mìng
sents.en: Maybe you're working too hard.

sents.zh: 你必须积极主动。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū jī jí zhǔ dòng
sents.en: You have to be proactive.

sents.zh: 硬币是金属做的。
sents.p: yìng bì shì jīn shǔ zuò de
sents.en: Coins are made of metal.

sents.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！
sents.p: wǒ tīng shuō nǐ tōng guò le rù xué kǎo shì gōng xǐ nǐ le
sents.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!

sents.zh: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。
sents.p: wàn yī lái bù liǎo wǒ huì xiān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
sents.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.

sents.zh: 万一我来晚的话，就别等我了。
sents.p: wàn yī wǒ lái wǎn de huà jiù bié děng wǒ le
sents.en: If by any chance I'm late, please don't wait for me.

sents.zh: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。
sents.p: qǐ chū tā yǐ wéi yīng yǔ hěn nán rú jīn tā jué de hěn jiǎn dān
sents.en: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.

sents.zh: 如今很多的货物都由飞机运送。
sents.p: rú jīn hěn duō de huò wù dōu yóu fēi jī yùn sòng
sents.en: Many goods are now transported by air.

sents.zh: 我不想独自前往。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng dú zì qián wǎng
sents.en: I don't want to go alone.

sents.zh: 我们想学一些日文歌曲。
sents.p: wǒ men xiǎng xué yī xiē rì wén gē qǔ
sents.en: We want to learn some Japanese songs.

sents.zh: 我们有个好极了的团队。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu gè hǎo jí le de tuán duì
sents.en: We have a great team.

sents.zh: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。
sents.p: xiàn dài kē xué jì shù ràng wǒ men de shēng huó gèng jiā shū shì
sents.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.

sents.zh: 他学习现代文学。
sents.p: tā xué xí xiàn dài wén xué
sents.en: He studies contemporary literature.

sents.zh: 你在东京如何维持生计？
sents.p: nǐ zài dōng jīng rú hé wéi chí shēng jì
sents.en: How did you make a living in Tokyo?

sents.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
sents.p: zhè jǐ nián duì zuò yè liáo fǎ de xū qiú zài xùn sù zēng zhǎng
sents.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

sents.zh: 谢谢您的迅速回复。
sents.p: xiè xie nín de xùn sù huí fù
sents.en: Thanks for your quick answer.

sents.zh: 你说得你好像什么都知道似的。
sents.p: nǐ shuō de nǐ hǎo xiàng shén me dōu zhī dào shì de
sents.en: You talk as if you knew everything.

sents.zh: 死了就像做梦似的。
sents.p: sǐ le jiù xiàng zuò mèng shì de
sents.en: Death is like dreaming.

sents.zh: 我必须去睡觉了！我明天早上有课。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū qù shuì jiào le wǒ míng tiān zǎo shang yǒu kè
sents.en: I have to get to sleep! I've got classes tomorrow.

sents.zh: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè nǐ bì xū zì jǐ jiě jué de wèn tí
sents.en: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.

sents.zh: 许多男生和女生都出席了。
sents.p: xǔ duō nán shēng hé nǚ shēng dōu chū xí le
sents.en: Many boys and girls were present.

sents.zh: 全班同学每周出席一次。
sents.p: quán bān tóng xué měi zhōu chū xí yī cì
sents.en: The whole class is present once a week.

sents.zh: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。
sents.p: nǐ shuō de huà gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn kè de yìn xiàng
sents.en: What you said left a deep impression on me.

sents.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。
sents.p: yǎn jiǎng zhě jīng cǎi de yǎn shuō gěi wǒ men liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng
sents.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.

sents.zh: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
sents.p: nǐ néng zài wǒ men de hūn lǐ shàng chàng gē jiù tài hǎo le
sents.en: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.

sents.zh: 你出席了我的婚礼。
sents.p: nǐ chū xí le wǒ de hūn lǐ
sents.en: You were at my wedding.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 她拿了其中一个玻璃花瓶。
ex.p: tā ná le qí zhōng yī gè bō li huā píng
ex.en: She picked up one of the glass vases.

ex.zh: 她把鼻子贴在玻璃上。
ex.p: tā bǎ bí zi tiē zài bō li shàng
ex.en: She pressed her nose against the glass.

ex.zh: 他转变了话题。
ex.p: tā zhuǎn biàn le huà tí
ex.en: He changed the topic of conversation.

ex.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
ex.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

ex.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
ex.p: yǒu kōng de shí hou wǒ zǒng xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè
ex.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.

ex.zh: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng gào sù wǒ zuì jìn de gǔ wán diàn zài nǎ lǐ ma
ex.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?

ex.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
ex.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

ex.zh: 我决定当个工程师。
ex.p: wǒ jué dìng dāng gè gōng chéng shī
ex.en: I've decided to become an engineer.

ex.zh: 他从头到脚都湿了。
ex.p: tā cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōu shī le
ex.en: He was wet all over.

ex.zh: 天气又冷又湿。
ex.p: tiān qì yòu lěng yòu shī
ex.en: The weather was not only cold, but also wet.

items.en: to lack; to be short of

ex.zh: 我们现在缺乏库存。
ex.p: wǒ men xiàn zài quē fá kù cún
ex.en: We're out of stock now.

ex.zh: 没有什么比做事缺乏热情更糟。
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ zuò shì quē fá rè qíng gēng zāo
ex.en: There is nothing worse than doing something in a half-hearted manner.

ex.zh: 天变暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。
ex.p: tiān biàn àn le wǒ bù zhī dào shì bù shì yào xià yǔ
ex.en: It's getting dark. I wonder if it's going to rain.

ex.zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
ex.p: wǒ hài pà yī gè rén chǔ zài hēi àn zhī zhōng
ex.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.

ex.zh: 他自认为他自己是个伟大的诗人。
ex.p: tā zì rèn wéi tā zì jǐ shì gè wěi dà de shī rén
ex.en: He thinks that he is a great poet.

ex.zh: 学生们用心学习了很多首诗。
ex.p: xué sheng men yòng xīn xué xí le hěn duō shǒu shī
ex.en: The students learned many poems by heart.

ex.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
ex.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

ex.zh: 你做什么类型的工作？
ex.p: nǐ zuò shén me lèi xíng de gōng zuò
ex.en: What sort of work do you do?

items.en: to lock; to lock up; a lock

ex.zh: 只要推门就好了。它自己会锁上的。
ex.p: zhǐ yào tuī mén jiù hǎo le tā zì jǐ huì suǒ shàng de
ex.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.

ex.zh: 你没有把你的车上锁吗？
ex.p: nǐ méi yǒu bǎ nǐ de chē shàng suǒ ma
ex.en: Didn't you lock up your car?

ex.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
ex.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

ex.zh: 我对人造语言不是很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì rén zào yǔ yán bù shì hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm not very interested in artificial languages.

ex.zh: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？
ex.p: nín kě yǐ zài chóng fù yī biàn gāng cái shuō de huà ma
ex.en: Could you please repeat what you just said?

ex.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si néng qǐng nín chóng fù yī biàn ma
ex.en: I beg your pardon?

ex.zh: 她有很强的个性。
ex.p: tā yǒu hěn qiáng de gè xìng
ex.en: She has a strong personality.

ex.zh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de míng zi jiā dào děng hòu pī zhǔn de shēn qǐng rén míng dān shàng ma
ex.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?

items.en: to go forward; to forge ahead

ex.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
ex.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
ex.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

ex.zh: 我准备再前进一点。
ex.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi zài qián jìn yī diǎn
ex.en: I've decided to go a little further.

items.en: another person; sb else; other people

ex.zh: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
ex.p: tā hé xǔ duō qí tā rén yī yàng wèn le wǒ tóng yàng de wèn tí
ex.en: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.

ex.zh: 我有问题，就像其他人一样。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu wèn tí jiù xiàng qí tā rén yī yàng
ex.en: I have problems, just like everybody else.

ex.zh: 他甚至骂我傻瓜。
ex.p: tā shèn zhì mà wǒ shǎ guā
ex.en: He even called me an idiot.

ex.zh: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。
ex.p: wǒ zěn me kě néng shì jī qì rén ne jī qì rén bù huì zuò mèng
ex.en: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.

ex.zh: 我认为这机器需要修理。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè jī qì xū yào xiū lǐ
ex.en: I think this machine is in need of repair.

ex.zh: 她永远也做不到保守秘密。
ex.p: tā yǒng yuǎn yě zuò bù dào bǎo shǒu mì mì
ex.en: She can never keep a secret.

ex.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
ex.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn rén hěn bǎo shǒu
ex.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.

items.en: to slip; to slide; slippery; smooth

ex.zh: 冬天有很多老人在冰上滑倒。
ex.p: dōng tiān yǒu hěn duō lǎo rén zài bīng shàng huá dào
ex.en: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.

ex.zh: 他每年冬天在北海道滑雪。
ex.p: tā měi nián dōng tiān zài běi hǎi dào huá xuě
ex.en: He skis in Hokkaido every winter.

ex.zh: 他能为你暗箱操作。
ex.p: tā néng wèi nǐ àn xiāng cāo zuò
ex.en: He can pull strings for you.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de cāo zuò xì tǒng shì nǎ gè
ex.en: What's your favorite operating system?

ex.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
ex.p: wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào zài sān nián zhī nèi dá chéng mù biāo
ex.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.

ex.zh: 我们要达成一些协定。
ex.p: wǒ men yào dá chéng yī xiē xié dìng
ex.en: We have to come to some agreement.

ex.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
ex.p: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
ex.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

ex.zh: 一个是日本人，另一个是意大利人。
ex.p: yī gè shì rì běn rén lìng yī gè shì yì dà lì rén
ex.en: One is Japanese and the other is Italian.

ex.zh: 几乎所有的日本人头发都是黑色的。
ex.p: jī hū suǒ yǒu de rì běn rén tóu fa dōu shì hēi sè de
ex.en: Nearly all Japanese have dark hair.

ex.zh: 只有个别人才懂了我的意思。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu gè bié rén cái dǒng le wǒ de yì si
ex.en: Only a few people understood me.

ex.zh: 这家里应该没有男人才对。
ex.p: zhè jiā lǐ yīng gāi méi yǒu nán rén cái duì
ex.en: There aren't supposed to be any men in this house.

ex.zh: 她是个有有魅力的女性。
ex.p: tā shì gè yǒu yǒu mèi lì de nǚ xìng
ex.en: She is a charming woman.

ex.zh: 你低估了你的魅力。
ex.p: nǐ dī gū le nǐ de mèi lì
ex.en: You underestimate your charisma.

ex.zh: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。
ex.p: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn guān yú wǔ dǎo de shū
ex.en: There's a book about dancing on the desk.

ex.zh: 我恐怕不是个很好的伙伴。
ex.p: wǒ kǒng pà bù shì gè hěn hǎo de huǒ bàn
ex.en: I'm afraid I wouldn't be very good company.

ex.zh: 你想要伙伴吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng yào huǒ bàn ma
ex.en: Do you want some company?

ex.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
ex.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me
ex.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

ex.zh: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā ào màn de tài du
ex.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.

ex.zh: 双方本周举行会谈。
ex.p: shuāng fāng běn zhōu jǔ xíng huì tán
ex.en: The two sides hold talks this week.

items.en: to feel with the hand; to touch

ex.zh: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。
ex.p: tā zài kǒu dài lǐ mō zhe zhǎo tā de qián bāo
ex.en: He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

ex.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
ex.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
ex.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

ex.zh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
ex.p: jié hūn shì suǒ yǒu lí hūn de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
ex.en: Marriage is the main cause of all divorces.

ex.zh: 她告诉他说，她想要离婚。
ex.p: tā gào sù tā shuō tā xiǎng yào lí hūn
ex.en: She told him she wanted a divorce.

ex.zh: 我不该退出的。
ex.p: wǒ bù gāi tuì chū de
ex.en: I shouldn't have logged off.

ex.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
ex.en: I forgot it in the garage.

ex.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

ex.zh: 他有权得到奖励。
ex.p: tā yǒu quán dé dào jiǎng lì
ex.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.

ex.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
ex.p: hú shàng de bīng tài báo le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
ex.p: zhè bīng tài báo bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
ex.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
ex.en: The house has all the conveniences.

ex.zh: 她把头发拍整齐了。
ex.p: tā bǎ tóu fa pāi zhěng qí le
ex.en: She patted her hair into place.
