lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第81单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 她拿了其中一个玻璃花瓶。
sents.p: tā ná le qí zhōng yī gè bō li huā píng
sents.en: She picked up one of the glass vases.

sents.zh: 她把鼻子贴在玻璃上。
sents.p: tā bǎ bí zi tiē zài bō li shàng
sents.en: She pressed her nose against the glass.

sents.zh: 他转变了话题。
sents.p: tā zhuǎn biàn le huà tí
sents.en: He changed the topic of conversation.

sents.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
sents.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
sents.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

sents.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
sents.p: yǒu kōng de shí hou wǒ zǒng xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè
sents.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.

sents.zh: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng gào sù wǒ zuì jìn de gǔ wán diàn zài nǎ lǐ ma
sents.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?

sents.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
sents.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
sents.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

sents.zh: 我决定当个工程师。
sents.p: wǒ jué dìng dāng gè gōng chéng shī
sents.en: I've decided to become an engineer.

sents.zh: 他从头到脚都湿了。
sents.p: tā cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōu shī le
sents.en: He was wet all over.

sents.zh: 天气又冷又湿。
sents.p: tiān qì yòu lěng yòu shī
sents.en: The weather was not only cold, but also wet.

sents.zh: 我们现在缺乏库存。
sents.p: wǒ men xiàn zài quē fá kù cún
sents.en: We're out of stock now.

sents.zh: 没有什么比做事缺乏热情更糟。
sents.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ zuò shì quē fá rè qíng gēng zāo
sents.en: There is nothing worse than doing something in a half-hearted manner.

sents.zh: 天变暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。
sents.p: tiān biàn àn le wǒ bù zhī dào shì bù shì yào xià yǔ
sents.en: It's getting dark. I wonder if it's going to rain.

sents.zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
sents.p: wǒ hài pà yī gè rén chǔ zài hēi àn zhī zhōng
sents.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.

sents.zh: 他自认为他自己是个伟大的诗人。
sents.p: tā zì rèn wéi tā zì jǐ shì gè wěi dà de shī rén
sents.en: He thinks that he is a great poet.

sents.zh: 学生们用心学习了很多首诗。
sents.p: xué sheng men yòng xīn xué xí le hěn duō shǒu shī
sents.en: The students learned many poems by heart.

sents.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
sents.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

sents.zh: 你做什么类型的工作？
sents.p: nǐ zuò shén me lèi xíng de gōng zuò
sents.en: What sort of work do you do?

sents.zh: 只要推门就好了。它自己会锁上的。
sents.p: zhǐ yào tuī mén jiù hǎo le tā zì jǐ huì suǒ shàng de
sents.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.

sents.zh: 你没有把你的车上锁吗？
sents.p: nǐ méi yǒu bǎ nǐ de chē shàng suǒ ma
sents.en: Didn't you lock up your car?

sents.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
sents.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

sents.zh: 我对人造语言不是很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì rén zào yǔ yán bù shì hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm not very interested in artificial languages.

sents.zh: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？
sents.p: nín kě yǐ zài chóng fù yī biàn gāng cái shuō de huà ma
sents.en: Could you please repeat what you just said?

sents.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？
sents.p: bù hǎo yì si néng qǐng nín chóng fù yī biàn ma
sents.en: I beg your pardon?

sents.zh: 她有很强的个性。
sents.p: tā yǒu hěn qiáng de gè xìng
sents.en: She has a strong personality.

sents.zh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de míng zi jiā dào děng hòu pī zhǔn de shēn qǐng rén míng dān shàng ma
sents.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?

sents.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
sents.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
sents.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

sents.zh: 我准备再前进一点。
sents.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi zài qián jìn yī diǎn
sents.en: I've decided to go a little further.

sents.zh: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
sents.p: tā hé xǔ duō qí tā rén yī yàng wèn le wǒ tóng yàng de wèn tí
sents.en: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.

sents.zh: 我有问题，就像其他人一样。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu wèn tí jiù xiàng qí tā rén yī yàng
sents.en: I have problems, just like everybody else.

sents.zh: 他甚至骂我傻瓜。
sents.p: tā shèn zhì mà wǒ shǎ guā
sents.en: He even called me an idiot.

sents.zh: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。
sents.p: wǒ zěn me kě néng shì jī qì rén ne jī qì rén bù huì zuò mèng
sents.en: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.

sents.zh: 我认为这机器需要修理。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè jī qì xū yào xiū lǐ
sents.en: I think this machine is in need of repair.

sents.zh: 她永远也做不到保守秘密。
sents.p: tā yǒng yuǎn yě zuò bù dào bǎo shǒu mì mì
sents.en: She can never keep a secret.

sents.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
sents.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn rén hěn bǎo shǒu
sents.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.

sents.zh: 冬天有很多老人在冰上滑倒。
sents.p: dōng tiān yǒu hěn duō lǎo rén zài bīng shàng huá dào
sents.en: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.

sents.zh: 他每年冬天在北海道滑雪。
sents.p: tā měi nián dōng tiān zài běi hǎi dào huá xuě
sents.en: He skis in Hokkaido every winter.

sents.zh: 他能为你暗箱操作。
sents.p: tā néng wèi nǐ àn xiāng cāo zuò
sents.en: He can pull strings for you.

sents.zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？
sents.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de cāo zuò xì tǒng shì nǎ gè
sents.en: What's your favorite operating system?

sents.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
sents.p: wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào zài sān nián zhī nèi dá chéng mù biāo
sents.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.

sents.zh: 我们要达成一些协定。
sents.p: wǒ men yào dá chéng yī xiē xié dìng
sents.en: We have to come to some agreement.

sents.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
sents.p: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
sents.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

sents.zh: 一个是日本人，另一个是意大利人。
sents.p: yī gè shì rì běn rén lìng yī gè shì yì dà lì rén
sents.en: One is Japanese and the other is Italian.

sents.zh: 几乎所有的日本人头发都是黑色的。
sents.p: jī hū suǒ yǒu de rì běn rén tóu fa dōu shì hēi sè de
sents.en: Nearly all Japanese have dark hair.

sents.zh: 只有个别人才懂了我的意思。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu gè bié rén cái dǒng le wǒ de yì si
sents.en: Only a few people understood me.

sents.zh: 这家里应该没有男人才对。
sents.p: zhè jiā lǐ yīng gāi méi yǒu nán rén cái duì
sents.en: There aren't supposed to be any men in this house.

sents.zh: 她是个有有魅力的女性。
sents.p: tā shì gè yǒu yǒu mèi lì de nǚ xìng
sents.en: She is a charming woman.

sents.zh: 你低估了你的魅力。
sents.p: nǐ dī gū le nǐ de mèi lì
sents.en: You underestimate your charisma.

sents.zh: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。
sents.p: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn guān yú wǔ dǎo de shū
sents.en: There's a book about dancing on the desk.

sents.zh: 我恐怕不是个很好的伙伴。
sents.p: wǒ kǒng pà bù shì gè hěn hǎo de huǒ bàn
sents.en: I'm afraid I wouldn't be very good company.

sents.zh: 你想要伙伴吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng yào huǒ bàn ma
sents.en: Do you want some company?

sents.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
sents.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me
sents.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

sents.zh: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā ào màn de tài du
sents.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.

sents.zh: 双方本周举行会谈。
sents.p: shuāng fāng běn zhōu jǔ xíng huì tán
sents.en: The two sides hold talks this week.

sents.zh: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。
sents.p: tā zài kǒu dài lǐ mō zhe zhǎo tā de qián bāo
sents.en: He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

sents.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
sents.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
sents.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

sents.zh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
sents.p: jié hūn shì suǒ yǒu lí hūn de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
sents.en: Marriage is the main cause of all divorces.

sents.zh: 她告诉他说，她想要离婚。
sents.p: tā gào sù tā shuō tā xiǎng yào lí hūn
sents.en: She told him she wanted a divorce.

sents.zh: 我不该退出的。
sents.p: wǒ bù gāi tuì chū de
sents.en: I shouldn't have logged off.

sents.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
sents.en: I forgot it in the garage.

sents.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
sents.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

sents.zh: 他有权得到奖励。
sents.p: tā yǒu quán dé dào jiǎng lì
sents.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.

sents.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sents.p: hú shàng de bīng tài báo le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
sents.p: zhè bīng tài báo bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
sents.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
sents.en: The house has all the conveniences.

sents.zh: 她把头发拍整齐了。
sents.p: tā bǎ tóu fa pāi zhěng qí le
sents.en: She patted her hair into place.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
ex.p: rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo
ex.en: Japan has a high population density.

ex.zh: 日本的人口比英国多。
ex.p: rì běn de rén kǒu bǐ yīng guó duō
ex.en: The population of Japan is larger than that of Britain.

ex.zh: 美貌只是表面性的东西。
ex.p: měi mào zhǐ shì biǎo miàn xìng de dōng xi
ex.en: Beauty is but skin deep.

ex.zh: 重力将一切带下地球表面。
ex.p: zhòng lì jiāng yī qiè dài xià dì qiú biǎo miàn
ex.en: Gravity brings everything down to Earth.

ex.zh: 据我所知，事情很顺利。
ex.p: jù wǒ suǒ zhī shì qing hěn shùn lì
ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, things are going well.

ex.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
ex.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

ex.zh: 我一直想登富士山。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng dēng fù shì shān
ex.en: I've always wanted to climb Mt. Fuji.

ex.zh: 明天，他将登上月球。
ex.p: míng tiān tā jiāng dēng shàng yuè qiú
ex.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

ex.zh: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。
ex.p: bù xìng de shì wǒ bì xū měi tiān zǎo qǐ
ex.en: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.

ex.zh: 很不幸，没有人在身边。
ex.p: hěn bù xìng méi yǒu rén zài shēn biān
ex.en: Unfortunately, there was no one around.

items.en: to lead; to be in front

ex.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
ex.p: jiǔ de xiāo fèi měi nián dōu zài shàng shēng
ex.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

ex.zh: 河的水位上升了。
ex.p: hé de shuǐ wèi shàng shēng le
ex.en: The river's water level has risen.

ex.zh: 他住在公园周围的某个地方。
ex.p: tā zhù zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi de mǒu gè dì fāng
ex.en: He lives somewhere around the park.

ex.zh: 她太矮了，看不到围墙外面。
ex.p: tā tài ǎi le kàn bù dào wéi qiáng wài miàn
ex.en: She was too short to see over the fence.

items.en: to care about; equivalent of 在于

ex.zh: 她不在乎她的穿著。
ex.p: tā bù zài hu tā de chuān zhù
ex.en: She doesn't care how she dresses.

ex.zh: 我不在乎是否下雪。
ex.p: wǒ bù zài hu shì fǒu xià xuě
ex.en: I don't care if it snows.

ex.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
ex.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng fēi xíng yuán
ex.en: My dream is to become a pilot.

ex.zh: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jì jiào tài duō shēng huó huì gēng róng yì xiē
ex.en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

ex.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
ex.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

ex.zh: 因为我付不了租金，我就向他请求帮助。
ex.p: yīn wèi wǒ fù bù liǎo zū jīn wǒ jiù xiàng tā qǐng qiú bāng zhù
ex.en: Since I couldn't pay the rent, I asked him for help.

items.en: to commemorate; to honor the memory of

ex.zh: 你觉得她最想要什么纪念品？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tā zuì xiǎng yào shén me jì niàn pǐn
ex.en: What souvenir do you think she would like most?

ex.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
ex.p: zhè jiāng shì wǒ huán rào měi guó lǚ xíng zhōng yī gè hěn hǎo de jì niàn pǐn

HSK 5 · 第82单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第83单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

ex.zh: 为什么你不在这里等到我做完为止？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ bù zài zhè lǐ děng dào wǒ zuò wán wéi zhǐ

ex.p: dào mù qián wéi zhǐ nǐ rèn wéi nǐ yuè dú guò duō shǎo shū jí

ex.zh: 请帮我叫宾馆保安。
ex.p: qǐng bāng wǒ jiào bīn guǎn bǎo ān
ex.en: Please get me hotel security.

ex.p: bié má fan bǎo ān le

ex.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。
ex.p: shí yàn shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le
ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。
ex.p: tā shī qù le píng héng cóng tī zi shàng shuāi le xià lai

ex.p: tā yǐ jīng kāi fàng le
ex.en: It's already open.

ex.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
ex.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
ex.en: The exhibition is now open.

ex.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
ex.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

items.en: to put out; to come up with

ex.zh: 你怎样作出的解释？
ex.p: nǐ zěn yàng zuò chū de jiě shì
ex.en: How do you account for that?

ex.p: zhè gè zhà dàn kě yǐ zhà sǐ hěn duō rén

ex.p: wǒ jué de wǒ de tóu yào zhà le
ex.en: I thought my head would explode.

ex.en: He's a regular at the bars and pubs around here.

ex.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
ex.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
ex.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

ex.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

ex.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

ex.zh: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。
ex.p: wǒ jǐn liàng liú zhe wèi chī tián diǎn
ex.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

ex.zh: 她很有可能会有所成就。
ex.p: tā hěn yǒu kě néng huì yǒu suǒ chéng jiù

items.en: to miss; to remember with longing

ex.zh: 难道你不想念什么吗？
ex.p: nán dào nǐ bù xiǎng niàn shén me ma
ex.en: Don't you miss anything?

ex.zh: 我会很想念你们的。
ex.p: wǒ huì hěn xiǎng niàn nǐ men de
ex.en: I'll miss you all so much.

ex.zh: 他预测会下雨。
ex.p: tā yù cè huì xià yǔ

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第84单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 今日的朋友是明日的敌人。
ex.p: jīn rì de péng you shì míng rì de dí rén
ex.en: Today's friends are tomorrow's enemies.

ex.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
ex.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng

ex.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
ex.p: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.

items.en: to arrive at (place or time); period

ex.zh: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi rèn zhēn kǎo lǜ zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò de shì
ex.en: You should seriously consider working here.

ex.zh: 我们都认为你的想法是行不通的。
ex.p: wǒ men dōu rèn wéi nǐ de xiǎng fǎ shì xíng bù tōng de
ex.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.

items.en: to be present; to be on the scene

ex.zh: 不要对批评太敏感了。
ex.p: bù yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le
ex.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

ex.p: tā gěi le hái zi yī gè wán jù
ex.en: He gave the child a toy.

ex.zh: 他收起了他的玩具。
ex.p: tā shōu qǐ le tā de wán jù
ex.en: He put away his toys.

ex.zh: 他跟您年纪差不多。
ex.p: tā gēn nín nián jì chà bù duō
ex.en: He is about your age.

ex.zh: 你该考虑他的年纪。
ex.p: nǐ gāi kǎo lǜ tā de nián jì
ex.en: You must take his age into account.

items.en: to keep in the mouth; to contain

ex.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
ex.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
ex.en: This word has two meanings.

ex.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me hán hu qí cí
ex.en: Why are you being so evasive?

ex.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
ex.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

ex.zh: 这对夫妇生了个儿子。
ex.p: zhè duì fū fù shēng le gèr zǐ
ex.en: The couple had a son.

ex.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
ex.p: tā zài cóng zì xíng chē shàng shuāi xià lai shí shāng dào le jiǎo
ex.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.

ex.zh: 你摔坏过你的眼镜吗？
ex.p: nǐ shuāi huài guò nǐ de yǎn jìng ma
ex.en: Have you ever broken your glasses?

items.en: to join; to connect; to link up; to communicate

ex.zh: 不能用手指人。
ex.p: bù néng yòng shǒu zhǐ rén
ex.en: Don't point at others.

ex.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
ex.p: jiào shī yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu

items.en: to promote; to lift; to hoist

ex.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.

ex.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà

ex.p: ràng wèi xīng huán rào dì qiú de shì zhòng lì
ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第85单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 今日的朋友是明日的敌人。
sents.p: jīn rì de péng you shì míng rì de dí rén
sents.en: Today's friends are tomorrow's enemies.

sents.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
sents.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
sents.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

sents.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
sents.p: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
sents.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.

sents.zh: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi rèn zhēn kǎo lǜ zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò de shì
sents.en: You should seriously consider working here.

sents.zh: 我们都认为你的想法是行不通的。
sents.p: wǒ men dōu rèn wéi nǐ de xiǎng fǎ shì xíng bù tōng de
sents.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.

sents.zh: 不要对批评太敏感了。
sents.p: bù yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le
sents.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

sents.zh: 他给了孩子一个玩具。
sents.p: tā gěi le hái zi yī gè wán jù
sents.en: He gave the child a toy.

sents.zh: 他收起了他的玩具。
sents.p: tā shōu qǐ le tā de wán jù
sents.en: He put away his toys.

sents.zh: 他跟您年纪差不多。
sents.p: tā gēn nín nián jì chà bù duō
sents.en: He is about your age.

sents.zh: 你该考虑他的年纪。
sents.p: nǐ gāi kǎo lǜ tā de nián jì
sents.en: You must take his age into account.

sents.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
sents.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
sents.en: This word has two meanings.

sents.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me hán hu qí cí
sents.en: Why are you being so evasive?

sents.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
sents.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

sents.zh: 这对夫妇生了个儿子。
sents.p: zhè duì fū fù shēng le gèr zǐ
sents.en: The couple had a son.

sents.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
sents.p: tā zài cóng zì xíng chē shàng shuāi xià lai shí shāng dào le jiǎo
sents.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.

sents.zh: 你摔坏过你的眼镜吗？
sents.p: nǐ shuāi huài guò nǐ de yǎn jìng ma
sents.en: Have you ever broken your glasses?

sents.zh: 不能用手指人。
sents.p: bù néng yòng shǒu zhǐ rén
sents.en: Don't point at others.

sents.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
sents.p: jiào shī yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu
sents.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

sents.zh: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？
sents.p: nǐ men zěn me dé chū zhè gè jié lùn de
sents.en: How do you come to that conclusion?

sents.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī zhǒng tí shēng jì yì lì de fāng fǎ
sents.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.

sents.zh: 他的化学很差。
sents.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà
sents.en: He is poor at chemistry.

sents.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
sents.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
sents.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

sents.zh: 天空变得越来越暗了。
sents.p: tiān kōng biàn de yuè lái yuè àn le
sents.en: The sky grew darker and darker.

sents.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
sents.p: ràng wèi xīng huán rào dì qiú de shì zhòng lì
sents.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.

sents.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
sents.p: zhè jiāng shì wǒ huán rào měi guó lǚ xíng zhōng yī gè hěn hǎo de jì niàn pǐn
sents.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.

sents.p: dǐ tè lǜ yīn tā de qì chē gōng yè ér chū míng

sents.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。

sents.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

sents.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
sents.en: The house has all the conveniences.

sents.zh: 我腰疼，不能打网球。
sents.p: wǒ yāo téng bù néng dǎ wǎng qiú
sents.en: I can't play tennis because my back hurts.

sents.zh: 有些乘客抱怨服务态度不好。
sents.p: yǒu xiē chéng kè bào yuàn fú wù tài du bù hǎo
sents.en: Some passengers complained about the service.

sents.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。
sents.p: tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn zhǐ shì zài bào yuàn
sents.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.

sents.zh: 你应该开始从事高尔夫。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi kāi shǐ cóng shì gāo ěr fu
sents.en: You should take up golf.

sents.p: nǐ zěn me xiǎng wú guān jǐn yào
sents.en: It doesn't matter what you think.

sents.zh: 此事与我无关。
sents.p: cǐ shì yǔ wǒ wú guān
sents.en: This has nothing to do with me.

sents.zh: 这是您的义务。
sents.p: zhè shì nín de yì wù
sents.en: That's your responsibility.

sents.zh: 这是一个奇迹。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè qí jì
sents.en: This is a miracle.

sents.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
sents.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
sents.en: The medicine worked marvels.

sents.zh: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。
sents.p: zài tā de bāng zhù xià wǒ de fǎ yǔ zhú jiàn jìn bù le

sents.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
sents.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

sents.p: tā yī zhěng tiān dōu chén mò bù yǔ

sents.p: zì cóng tā bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me de shí hou biàn yī zhí chén mò zhe

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 火车应当准点到。
ex.p: huǒ chē yīng dāng zhǔn diǎn dào
ex.en: The train should be on time.

ex.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
ex.p: tā jué de wǒ lǐ suǒ yīng dāng zhī dào dá àn
ex.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

ex.zh: 我还没觉得有那么糟糕。
ex.p: wǒ hái méi jué de yǒu nà me zāo gāo
ex.en: I didn't think it was so bad.

ex.zh: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
ex.p: ràng shì qing gēng zāo gāo de shì tā méi yǒu zhù yì dào tā dǎ rǎo dào le lín jū
ex.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.

items.en: in the sky; in the air

ex.zh: 天空中繁星点点。
ex.p: tiān kōng zhōng fán xīng diǎn diǎn
ex.en: The sky is full of stars.

ex.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
ex.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
ex.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

items.en: to link; to join; to connect
a copy of a film; film; motion picture; movie
to tear open; to tear down
to retire (from the workforce); to go into retir

ex.zh: 我爸爸明年春天就要退休了。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba míng nián chūn tiān jiù yào tuì xiū le
ex.en: My father is retiring next spring.

ex.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn liù shí suì jiù yào tuì xiū le
ex.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.

items.en: to treat as; to regard as

ex.zh: 他对自己的劳动成果很满意。
ex.p: tā duì zì jǐ de láo dòng chéng guǒ hěn mǎn yì
ex.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.

ex.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
ex.p: cóng tiān shàng kàn xià lai zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé
ex.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

ex.zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。
ex.p: zài huǒ chē de jiàn gé zhōng yǒu màn cháng de děng dài
ex.en: There is a long wait between trains.

ex.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
ex.p: tā men zhī jiān gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí
ex.en: They are separated by a great distance.

items.en: to equal; to be tantamount to

ex.zh: 二乘以二等于四。
ex.p: èr chéng yǐ èr děng yú sì
ex.en: Two times two is four.

ex.zh: 一加二等于三。
ex.p: yī jiā èr děng yú sān
ex.en: One plus two equals three.

ex.zh: 我明白这概念。
ex.p: wǒ míng bai zhè gài niàn
ex.en: I understand the concept.

ex.zh: 这条河是欧洲最宽的。
ex.p: zhè tiáo hé shì oū zhōu zuì kuān de
ex.en: This river is the widest in Europe.

ex.zh: 抱歉，我不是本地人。
ex.p: bào qiàn wǒ bù shì běn dì rén
ex.en: I am sorry. I am not from here.

ex.zh: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
ex.p: jù shuō tā bà ba zài wài guó qù shì le
ex.en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

ex.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
ex.p: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì
ex.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

ex.zh: 她照顾她的父亲直到他去世。
ex.p: tā zhào gu tā de fù qīn zhí dào tā qù shì
ex.en: She cared for her father until his death.

ex.zh: 老人今天早上去世了。
ex.p: lǎo rén jīn tiān zǎo shang qù shì le
ex.en: The old man passed away this morning.

ex.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。
ex.p: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì
ex.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

ex.zh: 我会给你你想要的任何事物。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ nǐ xiǎng yào de rèn hé shì wù
ex.en: I'll give you whatever you want.

ex.zh: 她总是尝试新事物。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì cháng shì xīn shì wù
ex.en: She is always trying new things.

ex.zh: 他的演讲持续了三个小时。
ex.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng chí xù le sān gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: His speech lasted three hours.

ex.zh: 他的演讲简短且切中要害。
ex.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng jiǎn duǎn qiě qiè zhōng yào hài
ex.en: His speech was short and to the point.

ex.zh: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yán sù de tán lùn nǐ de wèi lái
ex.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.

ex.zh: 我们认为这不严肃。
ex.p: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè bù yán sù
ex.en: We don't think it's serious.

items.en: to declare to be untrue; to deny

ex.zh: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。
ex.p: wǒ men wú fǎ fǒu rèn tā què shí shì hěn chéng shí de rén
ex.en: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.

ex.zh: 那个男孩否认偷了自行车。
ex.p: nà gè nán hái fǒu rèn tōu le zì xíng chē
ex.en: That boy denies stealing the bicycle.

ex.zh: 游泳锻炼肌肉。
ex.p: yóu yǒng duàn liàn jī ròu
ex.en: Swimming develops your muscles.

ex.zh: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me lái ān wèi nǐ
ex.en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

ex.zh: 我可以安慰她。
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ ān wèi tā
ex.en: I can comfort her.

items.en: to go up by one grade; to be promoted

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第86单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 火车应当准点到。
sents.p: huǒ chē yīng dāng zhǔn diǎn dào
sents.en: The train should be on time.

sents.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
sents.p: tā jué de wǒ lǐ suǒ yīng dāng zhī dào dá àn
sents.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

sents.zh: 我还没觉得有那么糟糕。
sents.p: wǒ hái méi jué de yǒu nà me zāo gāo
sents.en: I didn't think it was so bad.

sents.zh: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
sents.p: ràng shì qing gēng zāo gāo de shì tā méi yǒu zhù yì dào tā dǎ rǎo dào le lín jū
sents.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.

sents.zh: 天空中繁星点点。
sents.p: tiān kōng zhōng fán xīng diǎn diǎn
sents.en: The sky is full of stars.

sents.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
sents.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
sents.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

sents.zh: 我爸爸明年春天就要退休了。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba míng nián chūn tiān jiù yào tuì xiū le
sents.en: My father is retiring next spring.

sents.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn liù shí suì jiù yào tuì xiū le
sents.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.

sents.zh: 他对自己的劳动成果很满意。
sents.p: tā duì zì jǐ de láo dòng chéng guǒ hěn mǎn yì
sents.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.

sents.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
sents.p: cóng tiān shàng kàn xià lai zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé
sents.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

sents.zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。
sents.p: zài huǒ chē de jiàn gé zhōng yǒu màn cháng de děng dài
sents.en: There is a long wait between trains.

sents.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
sents.p: tā men zhī jiān gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí
sents.en: They are separated by a great distance.

sents.zh: 二乘以二等于四。
sents.p: èr chéng yǐ èr děng yú sì
sents.en: Two times two is four.

sents.zh: 一加二等于三。
sents.p: yī jiā èr děng yú sān
sents.en: One plus two equals three.

sents.zh: 我明白这概念。
sents.p: wǒ míng bai zhè gài niàn
sents.en: I understand the concept.

sents.zh: 这条河是欧洲最宽的。
sents.p: zhè tiáo hé shì oū zhōu zuì kuān de
sents.en: This river is the widest in Europe.

sents.zh: 抱歉，我不是本地人。
sents.p: bào qiàn wǒ bù shì běn dì rén
sents.en: I am sorry. I am not from here.

sents.zh: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
sents.p: jù shuō tā bà ba zài wài guó qù shì le
sents.en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

sents.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
sents.p: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì
sents.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

sents.zh: 她照顾她的父亲直到他去世。
sents.p: tā zhào gu tā de fù qīn zhí dào tā qù shì
sents.en: She cared for her father until his death.

sents.zh: 老人今天早上去世了。
sents.p: lǎo rén jīn tiān zǎo shang qù shì le
sents.en: The old man passed away this morning.

sents.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。
sents.p: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì
sents.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

sents.zh: 我会给你你想要的任何事物。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ nǐ xiǎng yào de rèn hé shì wù
sents.en: I'll give you whatever you want.

sents.zh: 她总是尝试新事物。
sents.p: tā zǒng shì cháng shì xīn shì wù
sents.en: She is always trying new things.

sents.zh: 他的演讲持续了三个小时。
sents.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng chí xù le sān gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: His speech lasted three hours.

sents.zh: 他的演讲简短且切中要害。
sents.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng jiǎn duǎn qiě qiè zhōng yào hài
sents.en: His speech was short and to the point.

sents.zh: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。
sents.p: wǒ men zài yán sù de tán lùn nǐ de wèi lái
sents.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.

sents.zh: 我们认为这不严肃。
sents.p: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè bù yán sù
sents.en: We don't think it's serious.

sents.zh: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。
sents.p: wǒ men wú fǎ fǒu rèn tā què shí shì hěn chéng shí de rén
sents.en: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.

sents.zh: 那个男孩否认偷了自行车。
sents.p: nà gè nán hái fǒu rèn tōu le zì xíng chē
sents.en: That boy denies stealing the bicycle.

sents.zh: 游泳锻炼肌肉。
sents.p: yóu yǒng duàn liàn jī ròu
sents.en: Swimming develops your muscles.

sents.zh: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me lái ān wèi nǐ
sents.en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

sents.zh: 我可以安慰她。
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ ān wèi tā
sents.en: I can comfort her.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
ex.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
ex.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

ex.zh: 这个价格含了税。
ex.p: zhè gè jià gé hán le shuì
ex.en: This amount includes tax.

ex.zh: 她把她儿子独自留在了车里。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā ér zi dú zì liú zài le chē lǐ
ex.en: She left her son alone in the car.

ex.zh: 我不相信孩子能独自到东京。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn hái zi néng dú zì dào dōng jīng
ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.

ex.zh: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。
ex.p: zhè nán rén shì zhe ān zhuāng tā zì jǐ de tiān xiàn
ex.en: The man tried to install his own antenna.

ex.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù
ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

items.en: the masses; the great bulk of the population

ex.zh: 我只是个大众脸。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì gè dà zhòng liǎn
ex.en: I'm just another man.

ex.zh: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。
ex.p: jiǎ rú néng yī gè yuè zhī nèi hái shàng de huà wǒ kě yǐ bǎ qián jiè gěi nǐ
ex.en: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.

ex.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
ex.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
ex.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

ex.zh: 有很多的方法可以改善人的一生。
ex.p: yǒu hěn duō de fāng fǎ kě yǐ gǎi shàn rén de yī shēng
ex.en: There are many ways to improve one's life.

ex.zh: 我想改善我的英语发音。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng gǎi shàn wǒ de yīng yǔ fā yīn
ex.en: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.

ex.zh: 木质房屋很容易着火。
ex.p: mù zhì fáng wū hěn róng yì zháo huǒ
ex.en: A wooden building can easily catch fire.

ex.zh: 这是一所现代房屋。
ex.p: zhè shì yī suǒ xiàn dài fáng wū
ex.en: It's a modern house.

items.en: variant of 记录 (but in Taiwan, not for the verb s

ex.zh: 农民总是抱怨天气。
ex.p: nóng mín zǒng shì bào yuàn tiān qì
ex.en: Farmers always complain about the weather.

ex.zh: 农民在春天播种。
ex.p: nóng mín zài chūn tiān bō zhòng
ex.en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

items.en: to fan; to slap sb on the face

ex.zh: 你有这扇门的钥匙吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhè shān mén de yào shi ma
ex.en: Do you have the key to this door?

ex.zh: 我想过扇你一巴掌。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng guò shān nǐ yī ba zhǎng
ex.en: I wanted to smack you.

items.en: to block up (a road, pipe etc)
to disseminate; to propagate; to spread
as one wishes; according to one's wishes

ex.zh: 稍微随意一点。
ex.p: shāo wēi suí yì yī diǎn
ex.en: Let your hair down a little.

ex.zh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
ex.p: tā tài guò hào qí yǐ zhì yú dǎ kāi le hé zi
ex.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.

ex.zh: 他对什么都感好奇。
ex.p: tā duì shén me dōu gǎn hào qí
ex.en: He's curious about everything.

ex.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
ex.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

ex.zh: 她用玫瑰花装饰了她的房间。
ex.p: tā yòng méi guī huā zhuāng shì le tā de fáng jiān
ex.en: She decorated her room with roses.

ex.zh: 我看见一个老太太穿过了马路。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī gè lǎo tài tai chuān guò le mǎ lù
ex.en: I saw an old woman cross the street.

ex.zh: 他是我太太认识的一个人。
ex.p: tā shì wǒ tài tai rèn shi de yī gè rén
ex.en: He is acquainted with my wife.

ex.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。
ex.p: tā qiáng diào le jiào yù de zhòng yào xìng
ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.

ex.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

ex.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
ex.p: yī gè chǒu nán rén qiāo le wǒ de mén
ex.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.

items.en: to consider as; to take to be

ex.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
ex.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
ex.en: They mistook him for his brother.

ex.zh: 要不我们找时间喝一顿。
ex.p: yào bù wǒ men zhǎo shí jiān hē yī dùn
ex.en: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.

items.en: to comply with; to abide by; to respect (an agre

ex.zh: 我们必须遵守规则。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū zūn shǒu guī zé
ex.en: We must obey the rules.

ex.zh: 我们总要遵守法律。
ex.p: wǒ men zǒng yào zūn shǒu fǎ lǜ
ex.en: We should always obey laws.

items.en: to keep a firm grip on

ex.zh: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù zhuā jǐn de huà nǐ jiù huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
ex.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

ex.zh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ zhuā jǐn nǐ hái néng gǎn shàng huǒ chē
ex.en: If you hurry you can still make the train.

items.en: to be in contact (with sb); to associate

ex.zh: 让我们试着好好相处。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men shì zhe hǎo hǎo xiāng chǔ
ex.en: Let's try to get along.

ex.zh: 他和他的邻居相处。
ex.p: tā hé tā de lín jū xiāng chǔ
ex.en: He is getting along with his neighborhood.

sents.zh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
sents.p: tā tài guò hào qí yǐ zhì yú dǎ kāi le hé zi
sents.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.

sents.zh: 他对什么都感好奇。
sents.p: tā duì shén me dōu gǎn hào qí
sents.en: He's curious about everything.

sents.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
sents.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
sents.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

sents.zh: 她用玫瑰花装饰了她的房间。
sents.p: tā yòng méi guī huā zhuāng shì le tā de fáng jiān
sents.en: She decorated her room with roses.

sents.zh: 我看见一个老太太穿过了马路。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī gè lǎo tài tai chuān guò le mǎ lù
sents.en: I saw an old woman cross the street.

sents.zh: 他是我太太认识的一个人。
sents.p: tā shì wǒ tài tai rèn shi de yī gè rén
sents.en: He is acquainted with my wife.

sents.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào le jiào yù de zhòng yào xìng
sents.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.

sents.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
sents.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

sents.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
sents.p: yī gè chǒu nán rén qiāo le wǒ de mén
sents.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.

sents.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
sents.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
sents.en: They mistook him for his brother.

sents.zh: 要不我们找时间喝一顿。
sents.p: yào bù wǒ men zhǎo shí jiān hē yī dùn
sents.en: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.

sents.zh: 我们必须遵守规则。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū zūn shǒu guī zé
sents.en: We must obey the rules.

sents.zh: 我们总要遵守法律。
sents.p: wǒ men zǒng yào zūn shǒu fǎ lǜ
sents.en: We should always obey laws.

sents.zh: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù zhuā jǐn de huà nǐ jiù huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
sents.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

sents.zh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ zhuā jǐn nǐ hái néng gǎn shàng huǒ chē
sents.en: If you hurry you can still make the train.

sents.zh: 让我们试着好好相处。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men shì zhe hǎo hǎo xiāng chǔ
sents.en: Let's try to get along.

sents.zh: 他和他的邻居相处。
sents.p: tā hé tā de lín jū xiāng chǔ
sents.en: He is getting along with his neighborhood.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 有一阵从北边吹来的冷风。
ex.p: yǒu yī zhèn cóng běi biān chuī lái de lěng fēng
ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.

ex.zh: 我看这雨还会下一阵子。
ex.p: wǒ kàn zhè yù hái huì xià yī zhèn zǐ
ex.en: I don't think this rain will let up anytime soon.

ex.zh: 在建筑物里的所有人都感觉到了地震。
ex.p: zài jiàn zhù wù lǐ de suǒ yǒu rén dōu gǎn jué dào le dì zhèn
ex.en: Everybody in the building felt the earthquake.

ex.zh: 没有人知道地震何时会来。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén zhī dào dì zhèn hé shí huì lái
ex.en: Nobody knows when the earthquake will occur.

ex.zh: 任何人都知道贝尔发明了电话。
ex.p: rèn hé rén dōu zhī dào bèi ěr fā míng le diàn huà
ex.en: Everyone knows Bell invented the telephone.

ex.zh: 电话是由贝尔发明的。
ex.p: diàn huà shì yóu bèi ěr fā míng de
ex.en: The telephone was invented by Bell.

items.en: to return to; to come (or go) back

ex.zh: 一个小时后，她返回了。
ex.p: yī gè xiǎo shí hòu tā fǎn huí le
ex.en: She came back an hour later.

ex.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。
ex.p: bào fēng xuě shǐ de wǒ men nán yǐ fǎn huí yíng de
ex.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.

ex.zh: 她手里拿着一朵玫瑰。
ex.p: tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī duǒ méi guī
ex.en: She has a rose in her hand.

ex.zh: 我花园里的一部分玫瑰是白色的，其他的是红色的。
ex.p: wǒ huā yuán lǐ de yī bù fen méi guī shì bái sè de qí tā de shì hóng sè de
ex.en: Some of the roses in my garden are white, and the others are red.

ex.zh: 他后悔自己的挥金如土。
ex.p: tā hòu huǐ zì jǐ de huī jīn rú tǔ
ex.en: He regrets his having wasted his money.

ex.zh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
ex.p: tā huī zhe tā de shǒu zhí dào huǒ chē xiāo shī zài shì xiàn zhī wài
ex.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

ex.zh: 就算我富有，我也不会给他钱。
ex.p: jiù suàn wǒ fù yǒu wǒ yě bù huì gěi tā qián
ex.en: Even if I were rich, I wouldn't give him money.

ex.zh: 你是个乐观主义者。
ex.p: nǐ shì gè lè guān zhǔ yì zhě
ex.en: You're an optimist.

ex.zh: 其他人不那么乐观。
ex.p: qí tā rén bù nà me lè guān
ex.en: Others are less optimistic.

ex.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。
ex.p: rì běn shì shì jiè gāo kē jì chǎn yè de lǐng tóu rén
ex.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.

ex.zh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。
ex.p: yóu jià shàng zhǎng de kě néng xìng hěn gāo
ex.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.

ex.zh: 我正在把价格涨一倍。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng zài bǎ jià gé zhàng yī bèi
ex.en: I'm doubling my prices.

ex.zh: 你我的问题很相似。
ex.p: nǐ wǒ de wèn tí hěn xiāng sì
ex.en: Your problem and mine are similar.

items.en: to hold a governmental office or post

ex.zh: 我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng wǒ men lù yòng le nǐ lái dān rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò
ex.en: I'm glad we hired you for this job.

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯在大庭广众说话了。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zài dà tíng guǎng zhòng shuō huà le
ex.en: You'll soon get used to speaking in public.

ex.zh: 据广播里讲，明天会下雪。
ex.p: jù guǎng bō lǐ jiǎng míng tiān huì xià xuě
ex.en: According to the radio, it'll snow tomorrow.

ex.zh: 我们大家住在同一个宿舍。
ex.p: wǒ men dà jiā zhù zài tóng yī gè sù shè
ex.en: We all live in the same dorm.

ex.zh: 他沉迷于语言学的研究。
ex.p: tā chén mí yú yǔ yán xué de yán jiū
ex.en: He is absorbed in the study of linguistics.

ex.zh: 我一整天都觉得很消沉。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhěng tiān dōu jué de hěn xiāo chén
ex.en: I was feeling blue all day.

ex.zh: 你是我最可靠的朋友。
ex.p: nǐ shì wǒ zuì kě kào de péng you
ex.en: You're the most reliable friend I have.

ex.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。
ex.p: tiān qì yù bào yī diǎn yě bù kě kào
ex.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.

ex.zh: 她下决心要成为秘书。
ex.p: tā xià jué xīn yào chéng wéi mì shū
ex.en: She's determined to become a secretary.

ex.zh: 他决心去英国。
ex.p: tā jué xīn qù yīng guó
ex.en: He is determined to go to England.

ex.zh: 我在修理回家路上捡到的收音机。
ex.p: wǒ zài xiū lǐ huí jiā lù shang jiǎn dào de shōu yīn jī
ex.en: I'm fixing the radio I found on my way home.

ex.zh: 你怎样让你的孩子们吃蔬菜？
ex.p: nǐ zěn yàng ràng nǐ de hái zi men chī shū cài
ex.en: How do you get your children to eat vegetables?

ex.zh: 我老婆在附近的超市买蔬菜。
ex.p: wǒ lǎo pó zài fù jìn de chāo shì mǎi shū cài
ex.en: My wife buys vegetables from a supermarket nearby.

ex.zh: 您对我说的话有什么要补充的吗？
ex.p: nín duì wǒ shuō de huà yǒu shén me yào bǔ chōng de ma
ex.en: Would you like to add anything to what I've said?

ex.zh: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？
ex.p: wǒ gāng cái shuō de nèi róng nǐ xiǎng bǔ chōng me
ex.en: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?

ex.zh: 你们这些家伙想去干什么？
ex.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo xiǎng qù gàn shén me
ex.en: What are you guys going to do?

ex.zh: 你们这些家伙去哪儿了？
ex.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo qù nǎr le
ex.en: Where did you guys go?

ex.zh: 他已经不是我最初见他那时的那个人了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng bù shì wǒ zuì chū jiàn tā nà shí de nà gè rén le
ex.en: He is not the man that he was when I first knew him.

ex.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
ex.p: rú hé kè fú rì yuán shēng gāo shì gè dà wèn tí
ex.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.

ex.zh: 他帮助我克服了困难。
ex.p: tā bāng zhù wǒ kè fú le kùn nan
ex.en: He helped me to get over the difficulties.

ex.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
ex.p: hú shàng de bīng tài báo le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
ex.p: zhè bīng tài báo bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 你需要装修你的房间。
ex.p: nǐ xū yào zhuāng xiū nǐ de fáng jiān
ex.en: You need to redecorate your room.

ex.zh: 我们偶然乘上了同一辆列车。
ex.p: wǒ men ǒu rán chéng shàng le tóng yī liàng liè chē
ex.en: We happened to be on the same train.

ex.zh: 我们偶然间乘了同一列列车。
ex.p: wǒ men ǒu rán jiān chéng le tóng yī liè liè chē
ex.en: We were on the same train by chance.

items.en: to convene (a conference or meeting); to convoke

ex.zh: 会议将在下周日召开。
ex.p: huì yì jiāng zài xià zhōu rì zhào kāi
ex.en: The meeting will take place next Sunday.

items.en: to replace; to take the place of

ex.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。
ex.p: sù liào dài tì le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de yuán liào
ex.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.

ex.zh: 她用人造黄油代替了黄油。
ex.p: tā yòng rén zào huáng yóu dài tì le huáng yóu
ex.en: She substituted margarine for butter.

ex.zh: 做运动有利于健康。
ex.p: zuò yùn dòng yǒu lì yú jiàn kāng
ex.en: Exercise is good for your health.

ex.zh: 他们是热爱和平的人。
ex.p: tā men shì rè ài hé píng de rén
ex.en: They are peace-loving people.

ex.zh: 他真的很热爱音乐。
ex.p: tā zhēn de hěn rè ài yīn yuè
ex.en: He really likes music a lot.

sents.zh: 我一整天都觉得很消沉。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhěng tiān dōu jué de hěn xiāo chén
sents.en: I was feeling blue all day.

sents.zh: 你是我最可靠的朋友。
sents.p: nǐ shì wǒ zuì kě kào de péng you
sents.en: You're the most reliable friend I have.

sents.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。
sents.p: tiān qì yù bào yī diǎn yě bù kě kào
sents.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.

sents.zh: 她下决心要成为秘书。
sents.p: tā xià jué xīn yào chéng wéi mì shū
sents.en: She's determined to become a secretary.

sents.zh: 他决心去英国。
sents.p: tā jué xīn qù yīng guó
sents.en: He is determined to go to England.

sents.zh: 我在修理回家路上捡到的收音机。
sents.p: wǒ zài xiū lǐ huí jiā lù shang jiǎn dào de shōu yīn jī
sents.en: I'm fixing the radio I found on my way home.

sents.zh: 你怎样让你的孩子们吃蔬菜？
sents.p: nǐ zěn yàng ràng nǐ de hái zi men chī shū cài
sents.en: How do you get your children to eat vegetables?

sents.zh: 我老婆在附近的超市买蔬菜。
sents.p: wǒ lǎo pó zài fù jìn de chāo shì mǎi shū cài
sents.en: My wife buys vegetables from a supermarket nearby.

sents.zh: 您对我说的话有什么要补充的吗？
sents.p: nín duì wǒ shuō de huà yǒu shén me yào bǔ chōng de ma
sents.en: Would you like to add anything to what I've said?

sents.zh: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？
sents.p: wǒ gāng cái shuō de nèi róng nǐ xiǎng bǔ chōng me
sents.en: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?

sents.zh: 你们这些家伙想去干什么？
sents.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo xiǎng qù gàn shén me
sents.en: What are you guys going to do?

sents.zh: 你们这些家伙去哪儿了？
sents.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo qù nǎr le
sents.en: Where did you guys go?

sents.zh: 他已经不是我最初见他那时的那个人了。
sents.p: tā yǐ jīng bù shì wǒ zuì chū jiàn tā nà shí de nà gè rén le
sents.en: He is not the man that he was when I first knew him.

sents.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
sents.p: rú hé kè fú rì yuán shēng gāo shì gè dà wèn tí
sents.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.

sents.zh: 他帮助我克服了困难。
sents.p: tā bāng zhù wǒ kè fú le kùn nan
sents.en: He helped me to get over the difficulties.

sents.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sents.p: hú shàng de bīng tài báo le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
sents.p: zhè bīng tài báo bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 你需要装修你的房间。
sents.p: nǐ xū yào zhuāng xiū nǐ de fáng jiān
sents.en: You need to redecorate your room.

sents.zh: 我们偶然乘上了同一辆列车。
sents.p: wǒ men ǒu rán chéng shàng le tóng yī liàng liè chē
sents.en: We happened to be on the same train.

sents.zh: 我们偶然间乘了同一列列车。
sents.p: wǒ men ǒu rán jiān chéng le tóng yī liè liè chē
sents.en: We were on the same train by chance.

sents.zh: 会议将在下周日召开。
sents.p: huì yì jiāng zài xià zhōu rì zhào kāi
sents.en: The meeting will take place next Sunday.

sents.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。
sents.p: sù liào dài tì le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de yuán liào
sents.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.

sents.zh: 她用人造黄油代替了黄油。
sents.p: tā yòng rén zào huáng yóu dài tì le huáng yóu
sents.en: She substituted margarine for butter.

sents.zh: 做运动有利于健康。
sents.p: zuò yùn dòng yǒu lì yú jiàn kāng
sents.en: Exercise is good for your health.

sents.zh: 他们是热爱和平的人。
sents.p: tā men shì rè ài hé píng de rén
sents.en: They are peace-loving people.

sents.zh: 他真的很热爱音乐。
sents.p: tā zhēn de hěn rè ài yīn yuè
sents.en: He really likes music a lot.

ex.zh: 我在东京出生长大。
ex.p: wǒ zài dōng jīng chū shēng zhǎng dà
ex.en: I was born and raised in Tokyo.

ex.zh: 你的论文写完了吗？
ex.p: nǐ de lùn wén xiě wán le ma
ex.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?

ex.zh: 你的论文还需要改进。
ex.p: nǐ de lùn wén hái xū yào gǎi jìn
ex.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

ex.zh: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。
ex.p: zài zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng xià xíng róng cí fàng zài míng cí qián miàn
ex.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.

ex.zh: 列车停下前别下车。
ex.p: liè chē tíng xià qián bié xià chē
ex.en: Don't get off the train till it stops.

ex.zh: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。
ex.p: dāng liè chē tíng zhǐ shí suǒ yǒu de chéng kè dōu xiǎng zhī dào fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.

ex.zh: 她用一个微笑迎接了我。
ex.p: tā yòng yī gè wēi xiào yíng jiē le wǒ
ex.en: She greeted me with a smile.

ex.zh: 无论老幼，人们都出来迎接贵客。
ex.p: wú lùn lǎo yòu rén men dōu chū lái yíng jiē guì kè
ex.en: People, old and young, all came out to greet the guests.

items.en: to improve; to make better; improvement

ex.zh: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。
ex.p: xiàn dài kē xué jì shù ràng wǒ men de shēng huó gèng jiā shū shì
ex.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.

items.en: to build; to construct; to establish; to develop

ex.zh: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。
ex.p: yī zuò xīn de jiào xué lóu zhèng zài jiàn shè
ex.en: A new school building is under construction.

ex.zh: 他学习现代文学。
ex.p: tā xué xí xiàn dài wén xué
ex.en: He studies contemporary literature.

ex.zh: 对于一个饥饿的人来说，任何食物都是美味。
ex.p: duì yú yī gè jī è de rén lái shuō rèn hé shí wù dōu shì měi wèi
ex.en: Hunger is the best sauce.

ex.zh: 谢谢你烤的美味蛋糕。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ kǎo de měi wèi dàn gāo
ex.en: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.

ex.zh: 一年过去了，但仿佛我们昨天还见过面似的。
ex.p: yī nián guò qù le dàn fǎng fú wǒ men zuó tiān hái jiàn guò miàn shì de
ex.en: A year has passed, but it's as if we saw each other only yesterday.

ex.zh: 那一刻，时间仿佛静止了。
ex.p: nà yī kè shí jiān fǎng fú jìng zhǐ le
ex.en: At that moment, time seemed to stand still.

ex.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
ex.p: zhè bù shì yī gè lòu dòng ér shì yī gè méi yǒu xiě jìn wén dàng de tè xìng
ex.en: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.

ex.zh: 铁路与公路平行。
ex.p: tiě lù yǔ gōng lù píng xíng
ex.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

ex.zh: 这个屋子里满是烟雾。
ex.p: zhè gè wū zi lǐ mǎn shì yān wù
ex.en: The room was full of smoke.

ex.zh: 我们在雾中迷了路。
ex.p: wǒ men zài wù zhōng mí le lù
ex.en: We got lost in the fog.

ex.zh: 年轻人伸出他的手，接着我和他握了手。
ex.p: nián qīng rén shēn chū tā de shǒu jiē zhe wǒ hé tā wò le shǒu
ex.en: The young man put out his hand and I shook it.

ex.zh: 他伸长了他的右手。
ex.p: tā shēn cháng le tā de yòu shǒu
ex.en: He extended his right arm.

ex.zh: 我父亲很穷并不让我觉得丢脸。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn hěn qióng bìng bù ràng wǒ jué de diū liǎn
ex.en: I'm not ashamed of my father being poor.

ex.zh: 富人有时会看不起穷人。
ex.p: fù rén yǒu shí huì kàn bù qǐ qióng rén
ex.en: The rich sometimes despise the poor.

ex.zh: 在日本生活消费很高。
ex.p: zài rì běn shēng huó xiāo fèi hěn gāo
ex.en: Life in Japan is expensive.

ex.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
ex.p: jiǔ de xiāo fèi měi nián dōu zài shàng shēng
ex.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

ex.zh: 为了她的重要约会，她精心打扮了一下。
ex.p: wèi le tā de zhòng yào yuē huì tā jīng xīn dǎ ban le yī xià
ex.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.

ex.zh: 我认为一部电影的乐趣远胜于任何一本书。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi yī bù diàn yǐng de lè qù yuǎn shèng yú rèn hé yī běn shū
ex.en: I think a movie is more entertaining than any book.

ex.zh: 我从不回复陌生人发来的电子邮件。
ex.p: wǒ cóng bù huí fù mò shēng rén fā lái de diàn zǐ yóu jiàn
ex.en: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.

ex.zh: 我周日从不在家。
ex.p: wǒ zhōu rì cóng bù zài jiā
ex.en: I'm never at home on Sundays.

ex.zh: 应该更谨慎地处理它。
ex.p: yīng gāi gēng jǐn shèn de chǔ lǐ tā
ex.en: It must be done more carefully.

ex.zh: 我一生都谨慎行事。
ex.p: wǒ yī shēng dōu jǐn shèn xíng shì
ex.en: I've been careful my whole life.

items.en: to hold; to grasp; to clench (one's fist)

ex.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
ex.p: wǒ jué bù huì wàng jì qù nián yǔ zǒng tǒng wò shǒu de qíng jǐng
ex.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

ex.zh: 她手里握着一把小阳伞。
ex.p: tā shǒu lǐ wò zhe yī bǎ xiǎo yang sǎn
ex.en: She was holding a small parasol in her hand.

items.en: to strive one's hardest; to spare no effort

ex.zh: 我们要尽力而为。
ex.p: wǒ men yào jìn lì ér wèi
ex.en: We have to do our best.

ex.zh: 他尽力帮她了。
ex.p: tā jìn lì bāng tā le
ex.en: He did his best to help her.

ex.zh: 在公车上，一个陌生人和我说了话。
ex.p: zài gōng chē shàng yī gè mò shēng rén hé wǒ shuō le huà
ex.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.

ex.zh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
ex.p: tā duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī gè wán quán mò shēng de rén
ex.en: She's a complete stranger to me.

items.en: along; to follow (a line, tradition etc)

ex.zh: 一个男孩正沿着街走。
ex.p: yī gè nán hái zhèng yán zhe jiē zǒu
ex.en: A boy is walking across the street.

ex.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。
ex.p: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu dào dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng de dì fāng yòu zhuǎn
ex.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.

ex.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
ex.p: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

ex.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
ex.p: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

ex.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
ex.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 富人有时会看不起穷人。
sents.p: fù rén yǒu shí huì kàn bù qǐ qióng rén
sents.en: The rich sometimes despise the poor.

sents.zh: 在日本生活消费很高。
sents.p: zài rì běn shēng huó xiāo fèi hěn gāo
sents.en: Life in Japan is expensive.

sents.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
sents.p: jiǔ de xiāo fèi měi nián dōu zài shàng shēng
sents.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

sents.zh: 为了她的重要约会，她精心打扮了一下。
sents.p: wèi le tā de zhòng yào yuē huì tā jīng xīn dǎ ban le yī xià
sents.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.

sents.zh: 我认为一部电影的乐趣远胜于任何一本书。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi yī bù diàn yǐng de lè qù yuǎn shèng yú rèn hé yī běn shū
sents.en: I think a movie is more entertaining than any book.

sents.zh: 我从不回复陌生人发来的电子邮件。
sents.p: wǒ cóng bù huí fù mò shēng rén fā lái de diàn zǐ yóu jiàn
sents.en: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.

sents.zh: 我周日从不在家。
sents.p: wǒ zhōu rì cóng bù zài jiā
sents.en: I'm never at home on Sundays.

sents.zh: 应该更谨慎地处理它。
sents.p: yīng gāi gēng jǐn shèn de chǔ lǐ tā
sents.en: It must be done more carefully.

sents.zh: 我一生都谨慎行事。
sents.p: wǒ yī shēng dōu jǐn shèn xíng shì
sents.en: I've been careful my whole life.

sents.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
sents.p: wǒ jué bù huì wàng jì qù nián yǔ zǒng tǒng wò shǒu de qíng jǐng
sents.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

sents.zh: 她手里握着一把小阳伞。
sents.p: tā shǒu lǐ wò zhe yī bǎ xiǎo yang sǎn
sents.en: She was holding a small parasol in her hand.

sents.zh: 我们要尽力而为。
sents.p: wǒ men yào jìn lì ér wèi
sents.en: We have to do our best.

sents.zh: 他尽力帮她了。
sents.p: tā jìn lì bāng tā le
sents.en: He did his best to help her.

sents.zh: 在公车上，一个陌生人和我说了话。
sents.p: zài gōng chē shàng yī gè mò shēng rén hé wǒ shuō le huà
sents.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.

sents.zh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
sents.p: tā duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī gè wán quán mò shēng de rén
sents.en: She's a complete stranger to me.

sents.zh: 一个男孩正沿着街走。
sents.p: yī gè nán hái zhèng yán zhe jiē zǒu
sents.en: A boy is walking across the street.

sents.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。
sents.p: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu dào dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng de dì fāng yòu zhuǎn
sents.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.

sents.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
sents.p: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
sents.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

sents.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

ex.en: Plastic does not burn easily.

ex.en: He turned over the matter in his mind.

ex.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.

ex.zh: 我的父母教育我应该尊敬老人。

ex.en: My parents taught me to respect my elders.

ex.en: I had trouble unwrapping the package.

ex.zh: 她养各种不同的宠物。
ex.p: tā yǎng gè zhǒng bù tóng de chǒng wù
ex.en: She kept various kinds of pets.

ex.zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。

ex.zh: 我最近一直睡眠不足。

ex.en: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately.

ex.zh: 我看见远处有灯光。

units.title: History and traditions
units.intro: Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

items.en: to improve; to take a turn for the better

ex.zh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
ex.p: wǒ men jìn qī nèi de qíng kuàng yīng gāi huì hǎo zhuǎn
ex.en: Our situation should improve in the near future.

items.en: early period; early phase; early stage

ex.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù huì shuō yīng yǔ nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yī gè hǎo de zhí wèi
ex.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

ex.zh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
ex.p: tā gěi wǒ jiǎng shù le tā de yī shēng
ex.en: He told me the story of his life.

ex.zh: 从前有个美丽的公主。
ex.p: cóng qián yǒu gè měi lì de gōng zhǔ
ex.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

items.en: or 帝国大厦 Empire State Building etc)

ex.zh: 他们的货品有着最高的品质。
ex.p: tā men de huò pǐn yǒu zhe zuì gāo de pǐn zhì
ex.en: Their goods are of the highest quality.

ex.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
ex.en: The quality of these products is the same.

items.en: to prevent; to take precautions against

ex.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
ex.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

ex.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
ex.p: wǒ jué bù huì wàng jì qù nián yǔ zǒng tǒng wò shǒu de qíng jǐng
ex.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

items.en: to compensate for loss; to indemnify

ex.zh: 进教室的时候请把帽子摘了。
ex.p: jìn jiào shì de shí hou qǐng bǎ mào zi zhāi le
ex.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.

ex.zh: 孩子们正在花园里摘花。
ex.p: hái zi men zhèng zài huā yuán lǐ zhāi huā
ex.en: The kids are picking flowers in the garden.

ex.zh: 我不相信商人。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn shāng rén
ex.en: I don't trust businessmen.

ex.zh: 我不认为那可以变得更糟
ex.p: wǒ bù rèn wéi nà kě yǐ biàn de gēng zāo
ex.en: I don't think that it can get any worse.

ex.zh: 没有什么比战争更糟的了。
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ zhàn zhēng gēng zāo de le
ex.en: Nothing is worse than war.

ex.zh: 他有几分像学者。
ex.p: tā yǒu jǐ fēn xiàng xué zhě
ex.en: He is something of a scholar.

ex.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù àn zhào ān quán shǒu xù lái de huà nǐ kě néng huì shòu shāng de
ex.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.

ex.zh: 手续费是多少？
ex.p: shǒu xù fèi shì duō shǎo
ex.en: How much is the commission?

items.en: a drama; a play; theater; script of a play

ex.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
ex.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
ex.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

items.en: to revolve around; to center on (an issue)

ex.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán shì zài ǒu rán de qíng kuàng xià fā xiàn le mì shì
ex.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

ex.zh: 我偶然发现了那家餐馆。
ex.p: wǒ ǒu rán fā xiàn le nà jiā cān guǎn
ex.en: I found that restaurant by accident.

ex.zh: 这句句子意思模糊。
ex.p: zhè jù jù zi yì si mó hu
ex.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.

ex.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào xiǎn wēi jìng hé wàng yuǎn jìng de chā bié ma
ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

ex.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
ex.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

ex.zh: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
ex.p: ràng wǒ lái gào sù nǐ wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

ex.zh: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。
ex.p: hěn bào qiàn nà gè wèn tí wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
ex.en: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.

items.en: to replace the old with new; to renew

ex.zh: 我必须更新我的护照。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū gēng xīn wǒ de hù zhào
ex.en: I must renew my passport.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第92单元

History and traditions

Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
sents.p: wǒ men jìn qī nèi de qíng kuàng yīng gāi huì hǎo zhuǎn
sents.en: Our situation should improve in the near future.

sents.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù huì shuō yīng yǔ nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yī gè hǎo de zhí wèi
sents.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

sents.zh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
sents.p: tā gěi wǒ jiǎng shù le tā de yī shēng
sents.en: He told me the story of his life.

sents.zh: 从前有个美丽的公主。
sents.p: cóng qián yǒu gè měi lì de gōng zhǔ
sents.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

sents.zh: 他们的货品有着最高的品质。
sents.p: tā men de huò pǐn yǒu zhe zuì gāo de pǐn zhì
sents.en: Their goods are of the highest quality.

sents.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
sents.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
sents.en: The quality of these products is the same.

sents.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
sents.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
sents.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

sents.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
sents.p: wǒ jué bù huì wàng jì qù nián yǔ zǒng tǒng wò shǒu de qíng jǐng
sents.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

sents.zh: 进教室的时候请把帽子摘了。
sents.p: jìn jiào shì de shí hou qǐng bǎ mào zi zhāi le
sents.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.

sents.zh: 孩子们正在花园里摘花。
sents.p: hái zi men zhèng zài huā yuán lǐ zhāi huā
sents.en: The kids are picking flowers in the garden.

sents.zh: 我不相信商人。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn shāng rén
sents.en: I don't trust businessmen.

sents.zh: 我不认为那可以变得更糟
sents.p: wǒ bù rèn wéi nà kě yǐ biàn de gēng zāo
sents.en: I don't think that it can get any worse.

sents.zh: 没有什么比战争更糟的了。
sents.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ zhàn zhēng gēng zāo de le
sents.en: Nothing is worse than war.

sents.zh: 他有几分像学者。
sents.p: tā yǒu jǐ fēn xiàng xué zhě
sents.en: He is something of a scholar.

sents.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù àn zhào ān quán shǒu xù lái de huà nǐ kě néng huì shòu shāng de
sents.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.

sents.zh: 手续费是多少？
sents.p: shǒu xù fèi shì duō shǎo
sents.en: How much is the commission?

sents.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
sents.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
sents.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

sents.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
sents.p: wǒ wán quán shì zài ǒu rán de qíng kuàng xià fā xiàn le mì shì
sents.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

sents.zh: 我偶然发现了那家餐馆。
sents.p: wǒ ǒu rán fā xiàn le nà jiā cān guǎn
sents.en: I found that restaurant by accident.

sents.zh: 这句句子意思模糊。
sents.p: zhè jù jù zi yì si mó hu
sents.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.

sents.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào xiǎn wēi jìng hé wàng yuǎn jìng de chā bié ma
sents.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

sents.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
sents.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
sents.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

sents.zh: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
sents.p: ràng wǒ lái gào sù nǐ wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ de lǐ yóu
sents.en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

sents.zh: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。
sents.p: hěn bào qiàn nà gè wèn tí wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
sents.en: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.

sents.zh: 我必须更新我的护照。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū gēng xīn wǒ de hù zhào
sents.en: I must renew my passport.

sents.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
sents.p: bù yào yīn wèi chī de tài duō ér rǎo luàn wèi de zhèng cháng xiāo huà
sents.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

sents.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
sents.p: zhè gè jiā tíng rè qíng de jiē dài le wǒ
sents.en: This family gave me a warm welcome.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
sents.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

items.en: to be good at; to be adept at

ex.zh: 他不善于记人名。
ex.p: tā bù shàn yú jì rén míng
ex.en: He's not good at remembering names.

ex.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。
ex.p: zhè zhāng shā fā qǐ mǎ kě yǐ zuò sān gè rén
ex.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.

items.en: to put to use; to apply

ex.zh: 有它的应用吗？
ex.p: yǒu tā de yìng yòng ma
ex.en: Is there an app for that?

ex.zh: 我删除了这个应用。
ex.p: wǒ shān chú le zhè gè yìng yòng
ex.en: I deleted the app.

ex.zh: 我们有一些令人鼓舞的消息。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu yī xiē lìng rén gǔ wǔ de xiāo xi
ex.en: We have some encouraging news.

ex.zh: 没有人鼓励他。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén gǔ lì tā
ex.en: Nobody encouraged him.

ex.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
ex.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn
ex.en: Most accidents happen near home.

ex.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
ex.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
ex.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

ex.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
ex.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shàng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xi
ex.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

ex.zh: 时间比什么都宝贵。
ex.p: shí jiān bǐ shén me dōu bǎo guì
ex.en: Time is more precious than anything else.

ex.zh: 日本的石油依靠进口。
ex.p: rì běn de shí yóu yī kào jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan depends on other countries for oil.

ex.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
ex.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
ex.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

ex.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
ex.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

ex.zh: 我要几个土豆。
ex.p: wǒ yào jǐ gè tǔ dòu
ex.en: I want some potatoes.

ex.zh: 把土豆切一下。
ex.p: bǎ tǔ dòu qiè yī xià
ex.en: Cut the potatoes.

items.en: to put on display; to exhibit

ex.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
ex.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
ex.en: The exhibition is now open.

items.en: to travel along a route (of vehicles etc)
eating and drinking; food and drink; diet

ex.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
ex.p: shū guǒ duì píng héng yǐn shí bì bù kě shǎo
ex.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

ex.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。
ex.p: tā tíng xià jiǎo bù kàn qǐ hǎi bào
ex.en: He paused to look at the poster.

ex.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。
ex.p: duì hóu zi lái shuō pá shù hěn róng yì
ex.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.

ex.zh: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。
ex.p: shān shàng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zi chèn dà wáng
ex.en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

ex.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
ex.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
ex.en: I really enjoy your company.

ex.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
ex.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
ex.en: You've got company.

ex.zh: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。
ex.p: wǒ mā ma yǎn hán zhe lèi kàn wǒ
ex.en: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.

ex.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
ex.p: zhè gè tī zi shì fǒu zú gòu jiān gù yǐ chéng shòu wǒ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

ex.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
ex.p: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

items.en: to bring relief; to alleviate (a crisis)

ex.zh: 我能跟任何人工作。
ex.p: wǒ néng gēn rèn hé rén gōng zuō
ex.en: I can work with anyone.

ex.zh: 我们经常听说日本人工作勤奋。
ex.p: wǒ men jīng cháng tīng shuō rì běn rén gōng zuò qín fèn
ex.en: We often hear it said that the Japanese are good workers.

ex.zh: 可以用万事达信用卡吗？
ex.p: kě yǐ yòng wàn shì dá xìn yòng kǎ ma
ex.en: Do you take MasterCard?

ex.zh: 我可以用哪些信用卡？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ yòng nǎ xiē xìn yòng kǎ
ex.en: Which credit cards can I use?

ex.zh: 乡间有很多树。
ex.p: xiāng jiān yǒu hěn duō shù
ex.en: The countryside has many trees.

ex.zh: 我看见天上有奇怪的东西。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn tiān shàng yǒu qí guài de dōng xi
ex.en: I saw something strange in the sky.

ex.zh: 你昨天上午打网球了吗？
ex.p: nǐ zuó tiān shàng wǔ dǎ wǎng qiú le ma
ex.en: Did you play tennis yesterday morning?

ex.zh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
ex.p: nà fáng zi yīn wèi qí shǎo yǒu de xíng zhuàng bèi tū xiǎn chū lái
ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.

ex.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
ex.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù
ex.en: We measured the depth of the river.

sents.p: wǒ shān chú le zhè gè yìng yòng
sents.en: I deleted the app.

sents.zh: 我们有一些令人鼓舞的消息。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu yī xiē lìng rén gǔ wǔ de xiāo xi
sents.en: We have some encouraging news.

sents.zh: 没有人鼓励他。
sents.p: méi yǒu rén gǔ lì tā
sents.en: Nobody encouraged him.

sents.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
sents.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn
sents.en: Most accidents happen near home.

sents.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
sents.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
sents.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

sents.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
sents.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shàng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xi
sents.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

sents.zh: 时间比什么都宝贵。
sents.p: shí jiān bǐ shén me dōu bǎo guì
sents.en: Time is more precious than anything else.

sents.zh: 日本的石油依靠进口。
sents.p: rì běn de shí yóu yī kào jìn kǒu
sents.en: Japan depends on other countries for oil.

sents.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
sents.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
sents.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

sents.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
sents.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
sents.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

sents.zh: 我要几个土豆。
sents.p: wǒ yào jǐ gè tǔ dòu
sents.en: I want some potatoes.

sents.zh: 把土豆切一下。
sents.p: bǎ tǔ dòu qiè yī xià
sents.en: Cut the potatoes.

sents.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
sents.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
sents.en: The exhibition is now open.

sents.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
sents.p: shū guǒ duì píng héng yǐn shí bì bù kě shǎo
sents.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

sents.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。
sents.p: tā tíng xià jiǎo bù kàn qǐ hǎi bào
sents.en: He paused to look at the poster.

sents.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。
sents.p: duì hóu zi lái shuō pá shù hěn róng yì
sents.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.

sents.zh: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。
sents.p: shān shàng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zi chèn dà wáng
sents.en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

sents.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
sents.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
sents.en: I really enjoy your company.

sents.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
sents.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
sents.en: You've got company.

sents.zh: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。
sents.p: wǒ mā ma yǎn hán zhe lèi kàn wǒ
sents.en: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.

sents.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
sents.p: zhè gè tī zi shì fǒu zú gòu jiān gù yǐ chéng shòu wǒ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

sents.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
sents.p: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

sents.zh: 我能跟任何人工作。
sents.p: wǒ néng gēn rèn hé rén gōng zuō
sents.en: I can work with anyone.

sents.zh: 我们经常听说日本人工作勤奋。
sents.p: wǒ men jīng cháng tīng shuō rì běn rén gōng zuò qín fèn
sents.en: We often hear it said that the Japanese are good workers.

sents.zh: 可以用万事达信用卡吗？
sents.p: kě yǐ yòng wàn shì dá xìn yòng kǎ ma
sents.en: Do you take MasterCard?

sents.zh: 我可以用哪些信用卡？
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ yòng nǎ xiē xìn yòng kǎ
sents.en: Which credit cards can I use?

sents.zh: 乡间有很多树。
sents.p: xiāng jiān yǒu hěn duō shù
sents.en: The countryside has many trees.

sents.zh: 我看见天上有奇怪的东西。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn tiān shàng yǒu qí guài de dōng xi
sents.en: I saw something strange in the sky.

sents.zh: 你昨天上午打网球了吗？
sents.p: nǐ zuó tiān shàng wǔ dǎ wǎng qiú le ma
sents.en: Did you play tennis yesterday morning?

sents.zh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
sents.p: nà fáng zi yīn wèi qí shǎo yǒu de xíng zhuàng bèi tū xiǎn chū lái
sents.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.

sents.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
sents.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù
sents.en: We measured the depth of the river.

ex.zh: 你的名字已经从名单删除了。

ex.zh: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yán cháng zhè lǐ de zhù sù duō jǐ tiān
ex.en: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

ex.zh: 他的要求如下。

ex.en: His request is as follows.

ex.zh: 这是场长久的战争。

ex.en: It's been a long war.

items.en: the Chinese nation; the Chinese people

ex.zh: 因为闹铃没有响，所以我继续睡下去了。

ex.en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.

ex.zh: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。
ex.p: mén líng xiǎng de shí hou wǒ zhèng zhǔn bèi chū mén
ex.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.

items.en: to view as; to see as

ex.zh: 我把你视为我最要好的朋友之一。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ nǐ shì wéi wǒ zuì yào hǎo de péng you zhī yī
ex.en: I consider you one of my closest friends.

ex.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
ex.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng
ex.en: He is regarded as the best doctor in the village.

ex.zh: 我觉得他有几分像个诗人。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā yǒu jǐ fēn xiàng gè shī rén
ex.en: I think he is something of a poet.

ex.zh: 他自认为他自己是个伟大的诗人。
ex.p: tā zì rèn wéi tā zì jǐ shì gè wěi dà de shī rén
ex.en: He thinks that he is a great poet.

ex.zh: 我们没有打断。
ex.p: wǒ men méi yǒu dǎ duàn
ex.en: We didn't break in.

ex.zh: 请不要打断我。
ex.p: qǐng bù yào dǎ duàn wǒ
ex.en: Please don't interrupt me.

items.en: to pay attention to; to emphasize

ex.zh: 请在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。
ex.p: qǐng zài bèi jiào dào míng zi zhī qián zuò zài yǐ zi shàng děng hòu
ex.en: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.

ex.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
ex.p: diàn huà yùn yíng shāng tí shì lái diàn rén děng hòu jiē tōng
ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

ex.zh: 我在我的院子里种了棵桃树。
ex.p: wǒ zài wǒ de yuàn zi lǐ zhǒng le kē táo shù
ex.en: I planted a peach tree in my yard.

ex.zh: 你想拿多少桃子就拿多少。
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng ná duō shǎo táo zǐ jiù ná duō shǎo
ex.en: Take as many peaches as you like.

ex.zh: 她用力地拍了球。
ex.p: tā yòng lì de pāi le qiú
ex.en: She hit the ball hard.

ex.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。
ex.p: wǒ men běn gāi kǎo lǜ yī xià xíng chéng
ex.en: We should've taken the schedule into consideration.

items.en: quiet; making little or no noise

ex.en: He slipped me a note.

ex.zh: 我悄悄把信给了他。
ex.p: wǒ qiāo qiāo bǎ xìn gěi le tā
ex.en: I slipped the letter to him.

units.title: Arguing a point
units.intro: Grammar focus: 总之; 何况; 不见得; a 400-character opinion essay

items.en: to promote (an idea or cause); to advance

ex.zh: 相互理解能促进和平。
ex.p: xiāng hù lǐ jiě néng cù jìn hé píng
ex.en: Mutual understanding promotes peace.

ex.zh: 领带和我的西装不配。
ex.p: lǐng dài hé wǒ de xī zhuāng bù pèi
ex.en: The tie doesn't go with my suit.

ex.zh: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de huī sè xī zhuāng ma
ex.en: Could I borrow your gray suit?

ex.zh: 写下你名字的大写字母。
ex.p: xiě xià nǐ míng zi de dà xiě zì mǔ
ex.en: Write your name in capitals.

ex.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
ex.p: zhí dào huì yì jié shù zhī qián dōu méi rén zhù yì dào tā bù zài
ex.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.

ex.zh: 本月结束之前请等待。
ex.p: běn yuè jié shù zhī qián qǐng děng dài
ex.en: Please wait until the end of this month.

ex.zh: 只有个别人才懂了我的意思。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu gè bié rén cái dǒng le wǒ de yì si
ex.en: Only a few people understood me.

ex.zh: 他总是对我很亲切。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì duì wǒ hěn qīn qiè
ex.en: He's always been kind to me.

ex.zh: 充足的休息十分重要。
ex.p: chōng zú de xiū xi shí fēn zhòng yào
ex.en: It's very important to get enough rest.

items.en: name (of a thing); name (of an organization)

ex.zh: 这个桌子被预约了。
ex.p: zhè gè zhuō zi bèi yù yuē le
ex.en: This table is reserved.

ex.zh: 我的钥匙就是在这附近丢失的。
ex.p: wǒ de yào shi jiù shì zài zhè fù jìn diū shī de
ex.en: I lost my key somewhere around here.

ex.zh: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
ex.p: xué shù zào jiǎ bǐ nǐ xiǎng xiàng de pǔ biàn
ex.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.

units.title: Arguing a point
units.intro: Grammar focus: 总之; 何况; 不见得; a 400-character opinion essay

items.en: attitude (of the heart); state of one's psyche

ex.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
ex.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn de qì hòu wēn hé
ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.

ex.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
ex.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn rén hěn bǎo shǒu
ex.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.

ex.zh: 这道题目没有一位老师会做。
ex.p: zhè dào tí mù méi yǒu yī wèi lǎo shī huì zuò
ex.en: None of the teachers could solve the problem.

items.en: to answer; to reply; to handle; to deal with

ex.zh: 电脑为我们节省了很多时间，解决了很多问题。
ex.p: diàn nǎo wèi wǒ men jié shěng le hěn duō shí jiān jiě jué le hěn duō wèn tí
ex.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.

ex.zh: 你为什么戴那条围巾？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me dài nà tiáo wéi jīn
ex.en: Why are you wearing that scarf?

ex.zh: 拍照片光线不够亮。
ex.p: pāi zhào piàn guāng xiàn bù gòu liàng
ex.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.

ex.zh: 你现在可以删除它。
ex.p: nǐ xiàn zài kě yǐ shān chú tā
ex.en: You can delete that now.

ex.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me huī fù yǐ shān chú de wén jiàn ma
ex.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?

ex.zh: 我们要在海边在烧烤架上烤肉。
ex.p: wǒ men yào zài hǎi biān zài shāo kǎo jià shàng kǎo ròu
ex.en: We'll have a barbecue at the beach.

ex.zh: 我喜欢烧烤食物。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan shāo kǎo shí wù
ex.en: I love barbecue.

ex.zh: 耐心对一个教师来说是必需的。
ex.p: nài xīn duì yī gè jiào shī lái shuō shì bì xū de
ex.en: Patience is essential for a teacher.

ex.zh: 你必需马上去那儿。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū mǎ shàng qù nàr
ex.en: It is necessary for you to go there immediately.

items.en: to hand over; to pass on; to deliver

ex.zh: 可以把牛奶递给我吗？
ex.p: kě yǐ bǎ niú nǎi dì gěi wǒ ma
ex.en: Can you pass me the milk?

ex.zh: “请把盐递给我。”“拿着。”
ex.p: qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ ná zhe
ex.en: "Pass me the salt, please." "Here you are."

ex.zh: 父母承担教育子女的责任。
ex.p: fù mǔ chéng dān jiào yù zǐ nǚ de zé rèn
ex.en: Parents are responsible for their children's education.

items.en: to plant; to grow (a crop); to cultivate
to ask about; to make some inquiries
to wrap; to pack; (computing) to package

ex.zh: 我觉得我们需要一个打包盒。
ex.p: wǒ jué de wǒ men xū yào yī gè dǎ bāo hé
ex.en: I think we need a doggy bag.

ex.zh: 我当时正忙着打包，因为我两天后要去法国。
ex.p: wǒ dāng shí zhèng máng zhe dǎ bāo yīn wèi wǒ liǎng tiān hòu yào qù fǎ guó
ex.en: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.

items.en: at set dates; at regular intervals

ex.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
ex.p: tā dìng qī qù kàn yá yī suǒ yǐ tā hěn shǎo yá tòng
ex.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.

ex.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
ex.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shàng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

ex.zh: 我已经读过很多种类的书了。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng dú guò hěn duō zhǒng lèi de shū le
ex.en: I've read many kinds of books.

ex.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
ex.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

items.en: ordinary people; the "person in the street"

ex.zh: 新鲜的水果对你的健康有益。
ex.p: xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ duì nǐ de jiàn kāng yǒu yì
ex.en: Fresh fruit is good for your health.

ex.zh: 深呼吸有益健康。
ex.p: shēn hū xī yǒu yì jiàn kāng
ex.en: It's healthy to breathe deeply.

ex.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
ex.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
ex.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

items.en: to rely on; to depend on

ex.zh: 你用什么浏览器？
ex.p: nǐ yòng shén me liú lǎn qì
ex.en: What browser are you using?

items.en: to look upon as; to regard as

ex.zh: 请问剧场后门在哪？
ex.p: qǐng wèn jù chǎng hòu mén zài nǎ
ex.en: Where is the stage door?

sents.zh: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū zài dào qī qián wán chéng zhè xiàng gōng zuò
sents.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.

sents.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
sents.p: tā men de hé tong zài zhè gè yuè dǐ dào qī
sents.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

sents.zh: 她昨天看见一个高大的男人。
sents.p: tā zuó tiān kàn jiàn yī gè gāo dà de nán rén
sents.en: She saw a tall man yesterday.

sents.zh: 他是一个高大的男孩。
sents.p: tā shì yī gè gāo dà de nán hái
sents.en: He's a tall boy.

sents.zh: 感谢您的光临。
sents.p: gǎn xiè nín de guāng lín
sents.en: Thanks for stopping by.

sents.zh: 该病人正逐步康复。
sents.p: gāi bìng rén zhèng zhú bù kāng fù
sents.en: The patient is steadily recovering.

sents.zh: 我们已是成年人了。
sents.p: wǒ men yǐ shì chéng nián rén le
sents.en: We're adults.

sents.zh: 这本书上写，大象能活过一百岁。
sents.p: zhè běn shū shàng xiě dà xiàng néng huó guò yī bǎi suì
sents.en: This book says that elephants live to be over 100 years old.

sents.en: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.

sents.zh: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。

sents.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.

sents.zh: 不好意思，我迷路了。
sents.p: bù hǎo yì si wǒ mí lù le
sents.en: Excuse me, I'm lost.

sents.zh: 他可能迷路了。
sents.p: tā kě néng mí lù le
sents.en: He may have lost his way.

sents.zh: 赠与比接受更让人觉得幸福。
sents.p: zèng yǔ bǐ jiē shòu gēng ràng rén jué de xìng fú
sents.en: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

sents.zh: 接受现金捐赠。
sents.p: jiē shòu xiàn jīn juān zèng
sents.en: Cash donations will be accepted.

sents.zh: 好多朋友和熟人来了。
sents.p: hǎo duō péng you hé shú rén lái le
sents.en: Quite a lot of friends and acquaintances have come.

sents.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
sents.p: dì tú shàng de lán xiàn dài biǎo hé liú
sents.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.

sents.p: wǒ fù mǔ nà yī dài jīng lì guò zhàn zhēng
sents.en: My parents' generation went through the war.

sents.zh: 我每天都帮我妈做家务。
sents.p: wǒ měi tiān dōu bāng wǒ mā zuò jiā wù
sents.en: I help my mother with the housework every day.

sents.p: zhè shì gè sǐ hú tòng
sents.en: It's a dead end.

sents.zh: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
sents.p: nǐ bù jiè yì wǒ guān chuāng ba wǒ yǒu diǎn zháo liáng le
sents.en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.

sents.zh: 我肯定着凉了。
sents.p: wǒ kěn dìng zháo liáng le
sents.en: I must have caught a cold.

sents.zh: 这是一把中式扇子。
sents.p: zhè shì yī bǎ zhōng shì shàn zi
sents.en: This is a Chinese fan.

sents.zh: 叉子从桌上掉了下来。
sents.p: chā zi cóng zhuō shàng diào le xià lai
sents.en: A fork fell off the table.

sents.zh: 我想要一把叉子。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī bǎ chā zi
sents.en: I'd like a fork.

sents.zh: 我父母通常用法语对话，即使我母亲的母语是英语。
sents.p: wǒ fù mǔ tōng cháng yòng fǎ yǔ duì huà jí shǐ wǒ mǔ qīn de mǔ yǔ shì yīng yǔ
sents.en: My parents usually speak to each other in French, even though my mother is a native English speaker.

sents.zh: “我爱你”用法语怎么讲？
sents.p: wǒ ài nǐ yòng fǎ yǔ zěn me jiǎng
sents.en: How do you say "I love you" in French?
